title: Customer-S&S-Genesys Cloud Architect (CCaaS)-Manager, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Genesys Cloud Architect (CCaaS), Technical Transformation
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Deloitte is seeking a Genesys Cloud Architect with deep expertise in cloud contact center platforms and a strong command of the latest AI capabilities. You will design and lead the delivery of intelligent customer engagement solutions that combine Genesys Cloud CX with generative AI, conversational AI, and advanced analytics. You will translate complex client objectives into scalable, secure, and AI-enabled architectures, and you will help organizations move from traditional contact centers to predictive, self-service, and agent-assist experiences that measurably improve customer outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Genesys Cloud CX engagements, including routing, IVR, digital channels, workforce engagement, and analytics
* Architect AI-driven experiences, including virtual agents, generative AI assistants, intent recognition, and self-service automation, integrated with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities (such as Genesys Cloud AI Studio, Agent Copilot, and Agent Assist)
* Design integrations with large language models and AI platforms (such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Anthropic Claude) using Genesys Cloud Data Actions, APIs, and middleware
* Define retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and knowledge base strategies to ground AI responses in client content, with appropriate guardrails
* Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI in the contact center, covering data privacy, bias monitoring, human-in-the-loop escalation, and model performance tracking
* Design speech and text analytics pipelines, including real-time sentiment, quality scoring, and conversation summarization, to drive operational insight
* Partner with business stakeholders and delivery teams to translate requirements into AI-enabled technical designs and business cases
* Conduct solution reviews, performance assessments, and risk evaluations throughout the project lifecycle
* Guide migrations from legacy on-premise or other CCaaS platforms to Genesys Cloud
* Mentor consultants and developers on Genesys Cloud configuration, AI tooling, and architectural patterns
* Contribute to thought leadership, proposals, and AI-enabled accelerators within the CX practice

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of experience in contact center technology, with at least 5 years hands-on with Genesys Cloud CX
* Genesys Cloud certification (Architect, Admin, or Developer) preferred
* Deep knowledge of Genesys Cloud Architect, Data Actions, APIs, and Journey capabilities
* Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompt design, evaluation, and integration into production systems
* Familiarity with conversational AI platforms, NLU, and voice bot design
* Experience integrating contact center platforms with CRM and enterprise systems (such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics)
* Strong understanding of WFM, Quality Management, and reporting/analytics within CCaaS environments
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executive audiences
* Willingness to travel to client sites as required

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI, and regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act, PCI, HIPAA) in regulated industries
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and knowledge retrieval architectures
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Genesys Cloud Platform API development
* Prior consulting experience in a client-facing role

**What You'll Bring**

* A consultative mindset and a passion for using AI to improve customer experiences
* Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and the discipline to evaluate them against business value
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Leadership skills to guide cross-functional teams toward shared outcomes

**Manager-level success measures**

* Architecture connects business outcomes to implementable Genesys Cloud and AI capabilities.
* AI-enabled journeys have clear controls, escalation paths, and operational ownership.
* Delivery teams understand design decisions and dependencies, with limited avoidable rework.
* Client stakeholders have visibility into progress, risks, and readiness for launch and operations.
* Teams are coached effectively and contribute to sustained client relationships

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

description:

Job Description: Innovation Lead

Seeking a visionary and hands-on Innovation Lead to drive the design, prototyping, and delivery of next-generation solutions across the organization. This leader will identify emerging technologies—particularly in Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI, cloud (AWS), and data platforms—and translate them into production-grade capabilities built on a strong .NET/Java engineering foundation. * Drive reliability, scalability, security, and execution speed across platforms.

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Evangelize best practices, reusable assets, and a culture of continuous learning.

**People leadership expectations**

* Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work.

title: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
  
  
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Management**

* Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment
* Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work
* Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
* Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members

**Capability Development & Resource Management:**

* Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it
* Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution
* Manage the team's budget, including headcount, software/infrastructure operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility

**Technical Direction & Architecture:**

* Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems
* Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases
* Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions
* Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency
* Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team

**Agentic SDLC & Code Quality:**

* Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e.g., Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles
* Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards

**Compliance & Regulatory Alignment:**

* Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards
* Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field
* Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams
* Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions
* Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications
* Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior
* Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills
* Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity
* Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries

**Technical Skills**

* AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
* Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps
* Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments
* Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e.g., AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e.g., AWS Neptune)
* Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc.), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
* AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification

**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong stakeholder management skills to influence non-technical Senior Stakeholders on complex architectural designs
* Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures

* Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized

Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Software/Platform Engineer II
description:
**Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Data Platforms (Azure)**
**About The Role**
Our Data Platforms team builds and runs the cloud foundation that data products depend on. We are looking for a Senior SRE to help keep our Azure platform reliable, secure, and fully automated. You will work with engineers across teams. You will write code, not just run systems, and you will help set the standard for how we build and operate.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, build, and run Azure infrastructure for our data platform, following the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and landing zone principles.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. This includes reusable modules, remote state, and safe, tested changes.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and platform releases.
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams.
* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana or similar) so issues are found early.
* Lead incident response and write blameless post-incident reviews. Follow up until the fixes are done.
* Automate repetitive work to reduce manual effort.
* Work with security and governance teams so the platform meets policy, using Azure Policy, RBAC, and guardrails.
* Mentor engineers and share good practices across the team.

**What You Bring**

* 6–9 years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (networking, identity, storage, compute, and governance).
* Good working knowledge of CAF and Azure landing zones.
* Strong Terraform skills, with proven delivery of production IaC.
* Solid DevOps practices: Git workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Scripting or coding skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Good understanding of observability, incident management, and capacity planning.
* Clear communication and a habit of working well with others.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Azure Log Analytics and writing KQL queries for troubleshooting, dashboards, and alerts.
* Experience with data services such as Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse, or Data Lake.
* Kubernetes (AKS) and containers.
* Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-305, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* Experience in a regulated industry, such as financial services or insurance.

**Why join us**
You will work on a platform that matters, with real ownership and room to shape how we do things. We value learning, automation, and a healthy on-call culture.

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role:**

We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use. It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.

**Job Location:**
Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Noida

**What you will be doing:**

•
**Delivering from the backlog.**
Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.

•
**Building across the stack.**
Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.

•
**Working with structured and unstructured data.**
Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.

•
**Integrating with enterprise platforms.**
Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.

•
**Applying AI where it earns its place.**
Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.

•
**Proving the work.**
Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.

•
**Shaping what gets built.**
You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.

**Skills and experience**

**Commercial experience**
: 8+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.

**Core languages:**
Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C# as a secondary language is welcome.

**Back end:**
Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.

**Front end:**
React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.

**Data:**
Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.

**Data formats**
: Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.

**Cloud:**
Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.

**AI engineering:**
Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.

**Engineering practice:**
Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.

***Highly regarded***

• Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform

• Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce

• Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware

• Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing

• Reporting and analytics platforms

• Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with API integrations, enterprise system connections, and automation platforms
* Demonstrated expertise with AI platforms and technologies, including agentic and generative AI
* Experience evaluating, testing, and rolling out new platform features in an enterprise environment
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple systems
* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

The following technical skills are required or preferred:

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and MCP gateways; experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven architectures
* Strong proficiency in Python and scripting languages for automation and tooling
* Experience with Databricks preferred
* Proficiency with database technologies (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and reporting frameworks
* Understanding of FinOps principles, token/cost tracking, and spend optimization
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT Codex, or similar)
* Experience with Flask, Posit/RStudio, or similar application development frameworks
* Proficiency with collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

**PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Primarily office-based at the Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel (0-10%). Job description:

Job Title: Cloud Automation Architect

Location: Hyderabad

The Role

We are looking for a senior automation architect who does not just write scripts — someone who builds production-grade automation frameworks from the ground up. You will own the full lifecycle: infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, self-healing, and monitoring. If you have spent years turning manual, fragmented ops into reliable, repeatable systems — this is built for you.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Ansible Automation Design and maintain enterprise-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Automate OS patching, configuration drift correction, security hardening, and compliance enforcement across AWS, Azure, VMware, and REST-integrated environments. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post-provisioning configuration.

AWS Cloud Automation Architect serverless and event-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well-Architected standards.

Kubernetes & Helm Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies.

Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps — with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in.

Security & Compliance Automation Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end.

Observability & Auto-Remediation Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry-driven triggers. Build self-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly.

ITSM Integration Integrate automation into SymphonyAI-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows.

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of hands-on infrastructure automation experience in enterprise environments

Expert-level Ansible engineering — advanced Jinja2 templating, dynamic inventory, custom module development

Strong Kubernetes and Helm expertise — chart authoring, multi-environment lifecycle management

Deep Terraform knowledge — reusable module design, remote state, CI/CD integration

Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting

Solid AWS architecture knowledge — serverless patterns, IAM design, multi-account networking

Bonus Points

GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux · OPA / Gatekeeper / Conftest · Multi-account AWS automation · Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd) · IaC testing with Molecule, Terratest, Checkov, or tfsec · AWS cost optimization automation

Why Join

Own automation end to end — not just a piece of it

Replace reactive, manual operations with intelligent, self-healing systems

Work across cloud, security, infrastructure, and platform engineering

Build patterns and frameworks the entire engineering org will adopt

Directly reduce MTTR, improve security posture, and accelerate cloud maturity

description:
**TECHNICAL ARCHITECT**

**Azure Healthcare Platform & Integration | Hands-on builder-architect | US Based Healthcare Platform**

**EXPERIENCE**

**8–10 years total**

**LOCATION**

**Hyderabad | Primarily WFO**

**ROLE TYPE**

**Full-time | Hands-on technical lead**

**The role in one sentence**

**PERSONALLY LEAD**
**the technical evolution of the client’s modernized backend and ensure that backend services, integrations, FHIR, Databricks, identity, security, and external platforms evolve as one coherent architecture.**

**This is not an ivory-tower architecture position.**

About the Role

**The client is building a modern, Azure-first healthcare platform.**
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect with 8–10 years of total technology experience who can architect, build, integrate, troubleshoot, and continuously evolve this ecosystem.

The Architecture You Will Unify

**Operational & Clinical:**
Healthie for care workflows; Azure Health Data Services / FHIR as the canonical clinical backbone; Redox for hospital interoperability.

**Backend & Integration:**
Azure API Management, Service Bus/eventing, Functions, Logic Apps, backend services, APIs, webhooks, integration contracts, retries, reconciliation and observability.

**Data & Intelligence:**
ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion Architecture, Unity Catalog, governed analytics and AI consumption.

**Engagement & Enterprise:**
HubSpot, Intercom, patient communications, downstream reporting, identity/EMPI, consent, governance and security controls.

What You Will Own and Lead

· Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the modernized backend and continuously evolve it as it scales.

· Define clear system boundaries and source-of-truth rules so FHIR, Healthie, Databricks, engagement systems and hospital integrations do not become competing data silos.

· Architect integration patterns across APIs, webhooks, Service Bus/events, batch, CDC and FHIR transactions; make practical sync-versus-async decisions.

· Define reusable patterns for idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, replay, reconciliation, schema evolution, versioning, correlation IDs and observability.

· Lead technical design across backend services, Redox/hospital flows, Healthie integration, FHIR mappings, identity crosswalks, CRM/communication integrations and any other new vendors (In future)

· Provide architecture leadership for Databricks, Delta Lake and Medallion design while allowing the Data Engineer to own day-to-day pipeline implementation.

· Drive identity and master-data architecture across FHIR Patient IDs, Healthie IDs, Redox/hospital MRNs, provider/facility identifiers and future EMPI/MDM capabilities.

· Embed HIPAA-aligned security, PHI minimization, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault, auditability, environment separation and least privilege into delivery.

· Establish pragmatic architecture discipline: Architecture Decision Records, reference patterns, technical standards, design reviews and code-review expectations.

· Mentor engineers, unblock difficult problems, challenge vendor designs, and step into implementation whenever a problem crosses team or system boundaries.

Experience Profile We Prefer

**8–10 years of total professional technology experience.**
The strongest candidates will have started with a solid software, backend, integration or platform engineering foundation and grown into progressively larger architecture responsibilities while remaining hands-on.

· Typically 3–5 years of increasingly significant design/architecture responsibility within the 8–10 year career span.

· Evidence of personally owning architecture for substantial production systems—not only proposals or RFPs.

· Recent code/design reviews, troubleshooting, PoCs, deployment or production involvement.

· Experience working directly with small engineering teams and making progress in ambiguous, evolving environments.

description:

**ModMed**
, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach:
**we hired doctors and taught them how to code.**

  Venture-Backed Company of the Year

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**
**Job Description Summary:**
**Our Mission & Vision**

* Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform.
* Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
* Our Core Values: Create customer delight | Save time | Innovate boldly, then make things happen | Align passion with purpose | Think big | Have fun | Do good.
* bold\*The Role: Technical Visionary for Reliability and Developer Velocity As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer at ModMed, you are a primary architect of our technical future. You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world-class care without interruption. This is a high-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight.

**Primary Responsibilities**
Core Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture
  
  

* Architectural Strategy & Technical Governance: Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high-performance, fault-tolerant, and cost-optimized multi-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time).
* Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups.
* Developer Platform Evolution & CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers.
* Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto-scaling dynamics, secure multi-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization.
* Proactive Infrastructure Security & Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good).
* Enterprise Triage & Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi-layered root-cause analysis, lead deep-dive post-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades.

**Technical Leadership & Culture Multiplication**

* Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high-impact cross-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good.).

**Role Requirements & Qualifications Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus.
* Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
* Engineering Tenure: 13–15+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments.
* AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures.
* Advanced Platform Stack: Professional-grade expertise architecting and managing production-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure-as-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale.
* Strategic Engineering & Tooling: Expert-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil.
* Executive-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low-level technical trade-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line-by-line code and architecture review.
* Mission Dedication: A strong desire to apply elite technical expertise toward modernizing healthcare infrastructure, protecting patient data integrity, and solving complex societal-scale challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's in Engineering or MCA.
* Industry Credentials: Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or relevant advanced Specialty certifications (Security, Advanced Networking).
* Distributed Systems Expertise: Direct experience managing high-throughput, event-driven streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis) or high-scale data warehouse solutions (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Snowflake).
* Community & Thought Leadership: A history of contributing to foundational open-source cloud-native projects, authoring technical white papers, or speaking at premier industry tech conferences (e.g., AWS re:Invent, KubeCon). ModMed Core Behavioral Competencies To thrive in this role, you should naturally embody our foundational competencies:
* Agility: Embraces change as a growth opportunity; learns from successes and failures and adapts to new challenges.
* Results Driven: Consistently achieves quality results, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to do the same.
* Company Culture: Actively contributes to our culture to keep this company awesome, acts with a values-first mentality, embraces differences, and creates a sense of belonging for all.
* Customer Focus: Builds strong, positive relationships (internally and externally) and delivers customer-centric solutions.
* bold\*ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:
* Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.
* bold\*PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.
* bold\*ModMed Technologies India Private Limited follows a strict, merit-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.

**We do not:**

* Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;
* Authorise any individual, employee, or third party to collect any such payments (regardless of nomenclature) to offer or facilitate or recruitment opportunities; or
* Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.

All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.
  
  
We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .
  
  

* bold\*ModMed Technologies India Private Limited will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

description:
**Job Details**

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, India (
  **100% Work from Office**
  )
* **Experience Required:**
  12–15 Years
* **Job Type:**
  Full-Time / Permanent
* **Client Context:**
  US-Based Fortune 200 Energy & Utilities Enterprise
* **Travel Requirement:**
  Active
  **US Business Visa (B1/B2)**
  required for potential immediate travel deployment

**About Us: The Prodigy DNA**

**At Prodigy Systems and Services**
, we are an
**AI-Native, extensive-engineering-focused enterprise**
that believes software engineering is an elite craft. For over
**14 years**
, we have maintained a deeply trusted, bulletproof foothold with our primary US Fortune 200 client. Today, we have a powerhouse family of
**70 elite engineers**
actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure.

We are a tight-knit family of professionals built on a core pillar of deep mutual respect. Our strengths are anchored in
**Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation**
. We are working hungry, driven to make a true difference in society and the world through hyper-velocity technological progress.

When you join Prodigy, you will experience:

* **Warm, brilliant colleagues**
  who push you to be your best engineering self.
* **A humble management team**
  that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing.
* **An environment of radical documentation:**
  We live by a strict operational doctrine:
  **"Over-communication is a mandatory requirement."**
  We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs.
  **If it is not in writing, it never happened.**

**Role Description & Intent**

**We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC)**
who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street—the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding.

This is strictly a
**production-code-producing role**
. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration.

**Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations**

* **Production Code Execution:**
  Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging
  **Microsoft .NET Core (C#)**
  and advanced
  **SQL Server**
  engineering.
* **AI-Autonomous Engineering:**
  Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like
  **Devin**
  ) and advanced tools (
  **ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf**
  ) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed.
* **Spec-Driven Development (SDD):**
  Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect.
* **Architectural Rigor:**
  Strictly apply
  **SOLID principles**
  and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable.
* **High-Scale Engineering:**
  Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle
  **0.5 Million+ active customers**
  and scale smoothly through
  **5 Million+ transactions daily**
  with bulletproof stability.
* **Hybrid Infrastructure Management:**
  Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary
  **On-Premises Data Center**
  while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to
  **AWS Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  .
* **Observability & Instrumentation:**
  Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary.
* **Cost-Sensitive Engineering:**
  Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction.

**Core Skills & Competencies**

* **Primary Stack:**
  Microsoft .NET C#, .NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures).
* **AI Engineering:**
  Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf.
* **Methodologies:**
  Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
* **Infrastructure:**
  Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation).
* **Observability:**
  Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation.
* **Industry Knowledge:**
  Prior experience in the
  **Texas Energy & Utilities sector**
  (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus.

**Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process**

1. **Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive**

* *Focus:*
  Severe testing of .NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals.

1. **Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge**

* *Focus:*
  A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code.

1. **Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design**

* *Focus:*
  Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency.

1. **Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit**

* *Focus:*
  Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.
