title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Office

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. Lead AI/ML, chemometric, and LLM capabilities for bioprocessing and industrial software, turning process data into reliable models and secure decision-support tools.

title: Principal Manager/Associate Director, Tech (QS Dev) – Core Tech
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to join our QS Dev team in Hyderabad as a Principal Manager / Associate Director. QS Dev – Core Tech is a specialized technology group responsible for developing and supporting the computing infrastructure that underpins the D. E. Shaw group’s quantitative trading and research. The team builds and maintains a broad portfolio of mission-critical systems — including HPC schedulers and orchestration, service management, container and environment management, GPU compute infrastructure, high-performance networking, distributed storage, and Linux platform engineering — to support both on-premises and cloud-based computer environments. QS Dev partners closely with quantitative researchers to design, implement, and optimize scalable technology that serves as the foundation for many of the firm’s most sophisticated trading strategies and analytics. In this role, you will lead a team of 10–15 engineers and serve as both a people leader and a subject-matter expert in distributed systems and platform engineering. You will be expected to balance hands-on technical leadership — including architecture reviews, design guidance, and code-level engagement where necessary — with the stakeholder management, operational rigor, and team-building responsibilities that define a high-performing engineering organization.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
This role involves leading and developing a team of 10–15 engineers, directly and through technical leads, while fostering a culture of ownership, intellectual rigor, and collaborative problem-solving. The leader will be responsible for performance management, promotion readiness, and career development, with a focus on identifying and cultivating future technical leaders. They will raise the technical bar by challenging skilled engineers to deepen their craft, sharpen their design instincts, deliver elegant and production-grade solutions to complex infrastructure problems, and expand their impact across the team’s systems. The role also requires creating an environment where engineers are empowered to make decisions, take calculated risks, and learn from failures through blameless retrospectives. From a technical leadership and architecture perspective, the role requires setting the technical direction and architectural standards for a broad portfolio of infrastructure systems, including compute orchestration and scheduling, environment and package management, GPU compute and high-performance computing, distributed storage, networking infrastructure, Linux platform engineering, virtualization, cloud and hybrid compute environments, SDLC tooling, CI/CD, and developer productivity infrastructure. The leader will drive architecture reviews and design discussions to ensure systems are reliable, performant, secure, and operable at scale, while remaining technically engaged through design and code reviews, critical-path decision-making, and debugging complex cross-system issues with the team. They will also define and enforce SLOs, operational runbooks, and incident-response protocols, lead capacity planning and resource optimization across compute, storage, and network infrastructure, evaluate emerging technologies and open-source tools through proof-of-concept assessments, and promote platform engineering best practices, architectural patterns, and technology standards across the organization through documentation, design reviews, and hands-on support.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* The ideal candidate is a technically deep engineering manager who combines expertise in distributed systems and infrastructure engineering with a demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of high-caliber engineers in a demanding, performance-sensitive environment.
* 10–15 years of progressive software engineering experience, with at least 3–4 years in an engineering management role leading teams of 10 or more engineers
* Robust programming expertise in one or more of Go, Rust, or Python, with the technical depth to conduct meaningful architecture and code reviews, and to make sound build-versus-buy decisions
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems — particularly compute orchestration, job scheduling, container platforms, or infrastructure comparable in complexity to Kubernetes, Borg, Mesos, or similar systems
* Proven track record in platform engineering or software infrastructure — building the foundational systems that other engineers and researchers depend on for development, build, deployment, and production operations
* Solid background in computing-heavy or high-performance computing environments, with working knowledge across the infrastructure stack (compute, storage, networking, GPUs)

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Technical Consulting — Revenue Cloud Advanced(RCA)
description:
**Description**
***The Manager, Technical Consulting — Agentforce & Revenue Cloud leads a team of Technical Consultants and Sr Technical Consultants delivering enterprise-scale migrations from legacy CPQ and billing platforms (Apttus/Conga, Zuora, Oracle CPQ, custom-built CPQ) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ + Billing + Revenue Lifecycle Management), and the design and deployment of Agentforce for revenue operations use cases. This role sits within Salesforce Professional Services' Global Delivery Centre (GDC) and is a 50% billable position — equally accountable for hands-on technical architecture delivery and people leadership of the Revenue Cloud and Agentforce migration track within the Migration Factory. You will act as the senior technical leader for quote-to-cash migration engagements, guiding the team through complex product catalogue migration, contract and subscription data migration, billing migration strategy, ERP integration design and Agentforce revenue agent configuration — while building a high-performing team of Revenue Cloud and AI migration specialists.***
**Responsibilities**

* People Leadership: Manage up to 15 direct reports (Sr Technical Consultants and Technical Consultants) across the Revenue Cloud and Agentforce migration track — responsible for hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management and career development.
* Technical Delivery (50% Billable): Act as the hands-on Technical Architect for complex Revenue Cloud migration engagements — owning CPQ solution design, product catalogue migration strategy, contract/subscription data architecture, billing migration design and Agentforce revenue agent configuration.
* Migration Factory Contribution: Drive the Revenue Cloud and Agentforce track within the Migration Factory — ensuring wave delivery adheres to factory standards, MDLC phase discipline and quality gates.
* Trusted Advisor: Serve as the senior technical point of contact for clients on Revenue Cloud migrations — building trusted relationships with CFOs, Revenue Operations leaders, Sales Operations and Enterprise Architects.
* Workshop Leadership: Lead and facilitate CPQ discovery workshops, pricing design reviews, billing architecture sessions and Agentforce agent design workshops with client stakeholders and internal delivery teams.
* Solution Design Governance: Review and approve all Revenue Cloud solution design documents, CPQ configuration designs, billing migration strategies and Agentforce agent blueprints — ensuring factory standard compliance.
* Product Catalogue & Contract Migration Oversight: Oversee the migration of complex product hierarchies, bundle structures, pricing waterfalls, active contracts, subscriptions, amendments and billing history — ensuring relationship integrity and ERP reconciliation accuracy.
* Agentforce Leadership: Guide the team in designing and deploying Agentforce agents for Revenue Cloud use cases — quote-assist agents, renewal agents, deal desk agents and revenue operations automation — post migration go-live.
* ERP Integration Governance: Oversee the design and validation of ERP integration patterns (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) for revenue recognition, AR and GL posting — ensuring billing data flows correctly post go-live.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify and manage solution risks — pricing rule conflicts, contract data skew, ERP posting mismatches, CPQ governor limits during bulk operations and Agentforce hallucination risks in revenue contexts.
* Practice Development: Drive internal initiatives to grow the Revenue Cloud and Agentforce migration practice — developing CPQ config accelerators, contract migration scripts, billing migration playbooks and Agentforce prompt template libraries.
* Metrics & Outcomes: Own and report on team utilisation, delivery velocity, defect density, client satisfaction (CSAT) and wave throughput metrics for the Revenue Cloud and Agentforce track.
* Hiring & Talent: Actively participate in hiring, interviewing and onboarding Revenue Cloud and Agentforce technical consultants — building pipeline of talent aligned to the Migration Factory's growth roadmap.

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development and experience in technical support
* 5+ years of operations management experience
* 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* Experience in facilities management, or experience in project management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
* Knowledge of six Sigma/Lean processes
* Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
* 2+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
* Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* GAI academic qualifications/certifications
* Experience as a tech solution architect

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplGAITechJuly26

title: Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering
description:
**Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering**

**Field**

**Detail**

**Job Title**

Principal Architect — Cloud, Agentic AI & Data Engineering

**Function / Practice**

Digital, Data & AI — Technology & Solutions

**Reports To**

Head of Architecture / Practice Head — Digital & AI

**Experience**

15+ years in software, data and cloud engineering, including 5+ years in an architect capacity

**Location**

Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Pune (Hybrid), with travel to client sites as required

**Employment Type**

Full-time, Permanent

**Grade / Band**

Principal Architect

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cyient is looking for a Principal Architect who can operate at the intersection of cloud platform engineering, agentic AI and modern data engineering — and who is equally comfortable in front of a customer as in a design review.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing architecture role. You will own end-to-end solution architecture for strategic engagements, shape winning proposals and RFP responses, build demos and proofs of concept alongside the delivery team, and set the technical direction that engineering teams execute against. You will also mentor architects and senior engineers, and partner with fellow architects across practices to drive reusable assets, accelerators and an active innovation agenda.

Success in this role looks like architecture decisions that survive production, customers who ask for you by name, proposals that convert, and a bench of engineers who are measurably stronger because you invested in them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution & Cloud Architecture**

* **Own end-to-end architecture**
  for large, multi-workstream programs spanning cloud infrastructure, data platforms and AI services.
* **Design cloud-native solutions**
  on Microsoft Azure (or AWS ) covering compute, networking, identity, integration, observability, cost management and security.
* **Define the non-functional architecture**
  — scalability, resilience, latency, availability, disaster recovery and multi-tenancy — and hold designs accountable to it.
* **Establish architecture governance**
  : reference architectures, design standards, review checkpoints, a technology radar and architecture decision records (ADRs).
* **Drive cloud modernisation**
  and migration strategy — landing zones, containerisation, microservices, event-driven patterns and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / Bicep / ARM).

**Agentic AI & Applied GenAI**

* **Architect agentic AI systems**
  — multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, planning and reflection loops, memory, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* **Select and integrate the AI stack**
  : LLM providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight models), orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP-based tooling) and vector / retrieval layers.
* **Design production-grade RAG**
  and knowledge-grounding pipelines — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citation.
* **Define AI evaluation and guardrails**
  : accuracy and hallucination benchmarks, red-teaming, prompt-injection defence, PII handling, cost and token governance, and model observability.
* **Operationalise LLMOps**
  — prompt versioning, CI/CD for AI assets, regression evaluations, drift monitoring and safe rollout patterns.
* **Champion Responsible AI**
  principles — transparency, traceability, bias assessment and auditability — aligned to client and regulatory expectations.

**Data Engineering & Platform**

* **Architect modern data platforms**
  — lakehouse and medallion architectures on Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake or equivalent.
* **Design batch and streaming pipelines**
  using Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, Azure Data Factory and dbt, with clear SLAs on freshness and data quality.
* **Establish data governance**
  : cataloguing, lineage, master data management, quality frameworks and access control (Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview).
* **Model data for both analytics and AI consumption**
  , ensuring the same governed assets serve BI, ML and agentic workloads.
* **Optimise for cost and performance**
  — partitioning, storage tiering, compute right-sizing and workload isolation.

**Customer Engagement & Presales**

* **Act as the senior technical face to the customer**
  — run discovery workshops, architecture reviews and executive briefings for both engineering and CxO audiences.
* **Translate business problems into solution options**
  , with honest trade-offs on cost, risk, time-to-value and long-term maintainability.
* **Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs and proactive proposals**
  — solution narrative, architecture diagrams, delivery approach, effort estimation, staffing model and risk register.
* **Build compelling demos and proofs of concept**
  with the team — tightly scoped, built fast, and mapped to a measurable customer outcome.
* **Support deal shaping**
  alongside sales and account teams: value articulation, differentiation, competitive positioning and defence of the proposed architecture.
* **Own the technical narrative post-win**
  , ensuring that what was sold is what gets designed and delivered.

**Leadership, Mentoring & Innovation**

* **Guide and mentor**
  architects, tech leads and senior engineers through design reviews, pairing, structured feedback and career conversations.
* **Collaborate with peer architects**
  across practices and geographies to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design conflicts and avoid duplicated effort.
* **Drive the innovation agenda**
  : identify emerging technologies, run experiments and spikes, and convert successful ones into reusable accelerators, frameworks and IP.
* **Build the capability bench**
  — define skill paths, run internal enablement sessions and raise the architectural maturity of the practice.
* **Represent Cyient externally**
  through whitepapers, conference talks, partner forums and customer advisory sessions.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in a formal architect role on large-scale distributed systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure (preferred) or equivalent depth in AWS or GCP — demonstrable production ownership, not design-deck experience alone.
* Proven delivery of at least one production agentic AI or applied GenAI solution, from architecture through evaluation, guardrails and go-live.
* Strong data engineering background: lakehouse architectures, distributed processing (Spark), streaming and enterprise-scale data governance.
* Demonstrated presales and customer-facing track record — owned technical solutioning on proposals and RFPs that converted.
* Hands-on coding credibility in Python and one of Java / C# / Scala; able to build a POC personally when it matters.
* Experience with DevOps and platform engineering practices: CI/CD, IaC, containerisation, Kubernetes and observability tooling.
* Track record of mentoring senior technical talent and leading architecture communities of practice.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to hold a room of engineers and a room of executives with equal effect.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or AI Engineer Associate (AI-103); equivalent AWS certifications equally valued.
* Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric certification.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent interoperability standards and enterprise agent platforms.
* Domain exposure in one or more Cyient focus verticals: Aerospace & Defence, Rail & Transportation, Energy & Utilities, MedTech / Healthcare, Semiconductor or Communications.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, platforms or IP adopted across multiple accounts.
* Prior work in a services, consulting or systems-integrator environment with multi-client, multi-geography delivery.
* Published thought leadership, patents or active open-source contribution.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS SNAPSHOT**

**Area**

**Technologies & Practices**

**Cloud Platforms**

Azure (AKS, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor); AWS or GCP equivalents

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, open-weight LLMs; LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, MCP; RAG, vector stores, evaluations, guardrails, LLMOps

**Data Engineering**

Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Snowflake; Spark, Kafka / Event Hubs, ADF, dbt, Delta Lake; Purview, Unity Catalog

**Architecture Patterns**

Microservices, event-driven, domain-driven design, API-first, lakehouse / medallion, multi-tenancy, zero-trust security

**Engineering & DevOps**

Python, SQL, Java / C# / Scala; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform / Bicep, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry

**Consulting Skills**

Discovery workshops, solution storytelling, estimation, RFP response, POC and demo build, executive communication

title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**
:
  
  
Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.
  
  
We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.
  
  
**About the opportunity:**
As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.
  
  
You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  
  
You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.
* Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Your technical toolkit:**
**Languages and software engineering**
Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.
  
  
**Models and AI ecosystem**
Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.
  
  
**Agentic AI engineering**
Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.
  
  
**Retrieval and search**
Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**
End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.
  
  
**Frameworks**
Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.
  
  
**MLOps and LLMOps**
CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.
  
  
**Data and ML foundations**
Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**Description**
Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.
  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.
  
  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

A day in the life
  
  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.
  
  
**About The Team**
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.

**AI & Gen AI Enablement**

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
Reporting to the Head of Data & AI and leading a small team of specialists, the role owns three things: Azure-based AI/BI and agentic offerings; Mivada's Responsible AI, data governance and AI assurance framework; and the Microsoft Data & AI partnership.
  
  
This role works alongside the Enterprise Architecture & Snowflake COE, the Solutioning & Databricks COE, Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement, and Client Engagement & Execution, and drives the governance, training and adoption program set out in Mivada's AI Strategy & Roll-Out Roadmap across the practice.
  
  
Team leadership and people management
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of 3–5 Azure AI/BI engineers and AI / data governance specialists, owning their performance, development and day-to-day workload allocation.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team members; act as the escalation point for technical, governance and client issues the team raises.
* Set goals and conduct regular performance reviews for direct reports; identify and act on development and career-progression needs.

Azure AI/BI and agentic solution design and delivery
  
  

* Design, build and productionise AI/BI and generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Foundry, including natural-language analytics (for example, Fabric data agents and Copilot in Power BI).
* Develop and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (for example, Foundry Agent Service, Copilot Studio or LangGraph-style supervisor/agent patterns) that connect governed enterprise data, models and knowledge sources to real business problems.
* Package proven patterns into named, reusable, sellable offerings with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead, contributing to the practice's goal of at least one client-facing AI-enabled capability.
* Hand over to Client Engagement delivery pods with clear designs, guardrails and runbooks, and provide technical assurance through delivery.

Data governance and trust
  
  

* Own the practice's data governance approach for AI and analytics: ownership and stewardship, classification, lineage, quality and cataloguing, using Microsoft Purview and, where relevant, Unity Catalog or Snowflake Horizon.
* Develop and deliver client-facing trust offerings such as AI governance operating models, data governance and AI-readiness assessments, and Copilot data-protection reviews.

Microsoft Data & AI partnership
  
  

* Own Mivada's Microsoft Data & AI partner relationship and partner-tier roadmap, including the Solutions Partner for Data & AI (Azure) designation and relevant specialisations.
* Lead Microsoft co-sell, joint go-to-market and partner-funded programs (for example, workshops, assessments and proofs of concept) together with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead.
* Build and maintain certified Microsoft Data & AI capability across the practice, including own hands-on delivery.
* Represent Mivada at Microsoft partner forums and build relationships with Microsoft partner development managers and solution specialists.

Internal AI enablement and capability uplift
  
  

* Build and maintain the reusable prompt/playbook library and templated workflows that move staff from ad hoc use (L1/L2) toward governed, team-level and client-facing use (L3+) on the practice's AI maturity scale.
* Recruit, train and coordinate the peer-coach network; deliver the role-based training tiers, including Responsible AI and AI literacy for all staff; track adoption, confidence and training completion each quarter.

Client and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Partner with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead on AI and governance pursuits, providing solution design, estimates and Responsible AI positions for proposals.
* Contribute Responsible AI and data-trust thought leadership, such as points of view, events and case studies, to build Mivada's reputation and visibility.
* Advise client executives and risk, privacy and compliance stakeholders on AI governance, guardrails and trade-offs in clear, non-technical terms.
* Keep current with the Azure, Fabric and Foundry roadmap and with AI regulation and standards; coach consultants in Azure AI delivery and Responsible AI practice.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a small technical team (line management, performance reviews, resourcing and capacity planning).
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Senior experience in data and AI engineering or consulting, with hands-on delivery on Microsoft Azure data and AI services (for example, Microsoft Fabric, Foundry, Azure OpenAI and Power BI).
* Practical experience building and productionising generative AI, natural-language analytics or agentic AI solutions.
* Experience designing or running enablement or training programs.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive, risk and compliance audiences.

**Desirable**

* HIGHLY DESIRABLE – Data, Agentic or AI certification across one or more of MS Azure, Databricks, Snowflake
* AI governance or data governance credentials (for example, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or DAMA CDMP).
* Experience managing a Microsoft partner relationship, including designation or specialisation audits and co-sell.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience; experience running a champion network or community of practice.

**Benefits**
**WHY JOIN US**
Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:
  
  

* Developing you is a key focus - we help you craft your career

* Doona Days - additional two days off for your mental health
* Fun is an everyday experience - we challenge you in a positive way so you enjoy your growth journey

* Opportunities to be more for yourself and others

**Who We Are**
At
**Mivada**
we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
  
  
Mivada is a high-growth technology consultancy, headquartered in Australia, offering services to both high-growth, mid-sized and global blue chip clients. We run a hybrid model with the majority of our team onshore, as well as an offshore capability in India. We have the ability to support global businesses 24/7 365. Our flexible approach and strong reputation have led to repeat work and growth.

title: CRM Solution/Data Architect (Senior Manager) – Pharma
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
Our CX Strategy & Digital Transformation team is building next-generation commercial, medical, and customer engagement capabilities powered by Salesforce, AI, Data Cloud, and advanced analytics. We are seeking a strategic and highly experienced architect who can design the future-state CRM and customer data ecosystem supporting scalable growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
  
  
The Senior Manager, CRM Solution & Data Architect will define and govern the enterprise CRM, customer data, integration, and engagement architecture. This role will serve as the primary architecture leader across Salesforce, Data Cloud, customer master data, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, and connected enterprise platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep Salesforce architecture expertise with strong data architecture, master data management, integration design, and pharmaceutical commercial process knowledge. The role will partner with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, data teams, security, and external partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.
  
  
**WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires full coverage of US Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) and is not a standard India daytime work schedule**
**Principal Responsibilities**
**CRM & Enterprise Solution Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end CRM architecture strategy supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
* Establish future-state architecture roadmaps across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, Marketing Cloud, and emerging AI capabilities.
* Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation guardrails.
* Develop and govern architecture standards, reusable design patterns, platform principles, and technology blueprints across the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate new technologies and vendor capabilities against enterprise architecture, security, data, and business priorities.

**Data Architecture & Customer 360 Strategy**

* Lead customer data architecture across HCP, HCO, KOL, patient, account, territory, consent, affiliation, and engagement data domains.
* Define Customer 360 architecture leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud, enterprise customer master platforms, and third-party data sources.
* Design scalable canonical and platform data models supporting engagement, commercial effectiveness, reporting, analytics, and AI.
* Establish data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, survivorship, matching, and identity-resolution standards.
* Drive master data management alignment across CRM, ERP, enterprise data platforms, IQVIA, and commercial applications.

**Integration & Platform Architecture**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce and Snowflake, IQVIA, customer master, ERP, data warehouse, marketing automation, patient services, sales enablement, and analytics platforms.
* Define API-led, middleware, batch, event-driven, and real-time integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure integration architecture meets scalability, resiliency, performance, monitoring, supportability, and security expectations.
* Guide delivery teams on platform interoperability, interface contracts, error handling, observability, and enterprise integration standards.

**AI, Analytics & Data Cloud Enablement**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI-enabled CRM, field productivity, customer engagement, and decision-support use cases.
* Lead architecture for Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein capabilities, predictive analytics, and customer intelligence initiatives.
* Ensure customer and engagement data is structured and governed to support segmentation, personalization, next best action, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish trusted, reusable datasets and reporting architecture.

**Governance, Compliance & Security**

* Define architecture governance covering design reviews, standards compliance, technology decisions, nonfunctional requirements, and release readiness.
* Ensure CRM and data solutions align with applicable pharmaceutical, privacy, security, and records-management requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA expectations.
* Establish security architecture standards for role-based access, classification, privacy, encryption, auditability, retention, and risk management.
* Lead architecture assessments for internal and vendor-delivered solutions, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation actions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted architecture advisor to Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital, Data & Analytics, Security, and IT leadership.
* Lead discovery sessions, architecture workshops, solution reviews, roadmap planning, and executive-level design discussions.
* Mentor solution architects, developers, data engineers, administrators, and technical leads while raising architecture maturity.
* Provide thought leadership on CRM modernization, customer data strategy, AI adoption, and pharmaceutical engagement technologies.
* Oversee consulting partners and ensure internal team members participate throughout the design journey to build sustainable knowledge and ownership.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in CRM, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or solution architecture, including leadership at a senior manager or equivalent level.
* 10+ years of Salesforce platform architecture experience with ownership of complex, enterprise-scale solutions.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of customer master data management, Customer 360, identity resolution, data governance, metadata management, and data quality.

description:

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Engineering Manager**

AI Agentic Platform – Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems.

As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering.

  Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success.
* **Agent Orchestration:**
  Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably.
* **Cross-Platform Agent Unification:**

* Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment

* Hands on AWS work across ECS Fargate, Lambda, EC2, IAM roles, RDS, S3, EKS, SNS and SQS, and API Gateway. Working knowledge of VPC and VPC endpoints is sufficient; the network foundation is owned by Cloud Platform and Security.
* Terraform: consume enterprise modules confidently, and contribute improvements back to Cloud Infra Engineering via merge requests when a pattern is missing.
* GitLab: author and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Trupipeline), run merge reviews, and onboard app teams onto the enterprise SDLC. GitLab is the primary source of record.
* Python automation with boto3 and AWS APIs: build reusable tools that wrap AWS services into simpler, safer, developer friendly workflows. Turning repeat manual tasks into a small Python utility is the default response, not the escalation.
* Reliability enablement: working knowledge of Resilience Hub, AWS Fault Injection Simulator, and Application Recovery Controller, OR the ability to automate them via boto3 so app teams can consume them without deep AWS expertise. Either path is acceptable; both is preferred.
* Labs and office hours: contribute to hands on labs, cover the daily office hours rotation, and convert repeat questions into docs or lab content.
* Dojo engagements: run dedicated 4 to 6 week engagements with app teams new to cloud, walking them through architecture, forecast, labs, and their first path to prod.
* Banking or financial services experience.
* Experience running or debugging containerized workloads in ECS Fargate or EKS in production.
* Exposure to any AWS reliability service, for example Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Simulator, backup and restore, or cross region DR.
* Basic AWS cost awareness: reading a cost report, understanding tagging for cost allocation.
* SQL sufficient to query a cloud inventory or cost dataset.
* Experience teaching, mentoring, or leading pair programming, brown bags, or workshops.
* Comfortable writing docs that reduce future tickets.

*Customer Experience Platform Engineering*
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate, and support cloud-native customer experience capabilities within an Amazon Connect-powered contact center ecosystem. This role uses AWS services, APIs, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code to extend Amazon Connect and deliver seamless experiences across voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent workflows, analytics, and enterprise systems. The ideal candidate combines hands-on AWS engineering expertise with experience in contact center technologies, customer journey design, and the operational needs of a large-scale customer experience platform. We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset and expect engineers to use AI-assisted practices responsibly to improve speed, quality, and innovation.
  
  
Technical Skills Framework
  
  
Primary skills are the tools and capabilities used by the team to perform the role. Each definition describes the core skill and its application within the Amazon Connect contact center ecosystem. Comparable skillsets represent adjacent experience that may transfer and accelerate onboarding, but are not technically aligned to the team’s current way of working.
