Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Experience Platform Engineering
  
  

* Design and develop cloud-native capabilities that extend Amazon Connect functionality and improve customer and agent experiences.
* Build services that enable customer self-service, routing enhancements, agent productivity, interaction processing, workflow orchestration, notifications, authentication, analytics, and experience optimization.
* Partner with Connect Engineers, Product Owners, architects, and business stakeholders to implement end-to-end customer journeys using Amazon Connect and supporting AWS services.
* Translate contact center and customer experience needs into scalable, reusable, and supportable technical capabilities.

Contact Center Ecosystem Integration
  
  

* Develop APIs, event-driven services, and integration patterns that connect Amazon Connect with enterprise systems and third-party contact center technologies.
* Build integrations supporting voice, chat, email, messaging, customer authentication, outbound communications, workforce processes, analytics, and customer engagement capabilities.
* Integrate contact center workflows with customer, policy, claims, knowledge, workforce, communication, reporting, and other enterprise platforms.
* Contribute to migration and modernization initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and platform scalability.

Cloud-Native Application Development
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and support serverless applications, APIs, microservices, and reusable platform services using Lambda, TypeScript, and related AWS technologies.
* Use event-driven and asynchronous patterns to process contact events, coordinate workflows, and decouple Amazon Connect from downstream systems.
* Design for resilience, scalability, performance, recoverability, security, and cost efficiency across the customer interaction lifecycle.

Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps
  
  

* Implement Amazon Connect supporting infrastructure and AWS services using CDK and repeatable deployment patterns.
* Build and maintain CI/CD automation, testing, quality gates, security scanning, and environment promotion processes.
* Apply least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and enterprise cloud governance standards.

API and Integration Engineering
  
  

* Design, secure, version, document, and operate APIs used by contact flows, agent applications, customer channels, and enterprise systems.
* Apply authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, observability, and governance standards.
* Evaluate integration alternatives and document architectural decisions and tradeoffs based on customer experience, operational, and technical requirements.

Platform Operations and Optimization
  
  

* Monitor production services and end-to-end contact center integrations, respond to incidents, and restore customer and agent capabilities.
* Use telemetry to identify customer journey failures, integration issues, performance constraints, and improvement opportunities.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements that increase reliability, recoverability, and operational supportability.
* Optimize cloud consumption while protecting customer experience, platform performance, and service resilience.

AI-First Engineering
  
  

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to routing, self-service, agent support, analytics, and engineering productivity.

Agile Delivery and Product Ownership
  
  

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Connect Engineers, architects, analysts, and Agile team members to refine requirements and user stories.
* Participate in planning, stand-ups, refinement, retrospectives, and demonstrations.
* Deliver working, production-ready customer experience capabilities aligned with sprint and program commitments.
* Use customer feedback, operational insights, and platform telemetry to continuously improve solutions.

Quality, Security, and Operational Excellence
  
  

* Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, contract, and regression tests appropriate to contact center services and integrations.
* Participate in code and design reviews and follow established engineering standards.
* Apply secure coding, privacy, data protection, cloud security, and enterprise compliance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Demonstrate end-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement.

**Required Experience**

* Hands-on experience building cloud-native applications, integrations, or platform services using AWS.
* Experience with contact center technologies or customer experience platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Five9, Cisco, or comparable platforms.
* Experience integrating contact center channels, routing, agent workflows, customer self-service, or interaction data with enterprise applications and services.
* Experience with Lambda, TypeScript or a comparable development language, API design, event-driven architecture, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience supporting production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and root cause analysis.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand customer journeys and translate contact center needs into cloud-native solutions
* Clear communication and effective collaboration across product, operations, architecture, Connect engineering, and enterprise technology teams
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment
* End-to-end ownership from design through production support and continuous improvement

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience integrating AWS services with Amazon Connect
* Experience building capabilities for voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service, agent desktop, workforce, or conversation analytics use cases
* Experience with contact center migration or large-scale customer experience platform transformation
* Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous integration patterns
* Experience with Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CloudWatch, Splunk, or comparable delivery and observability platforms
* AWS Developer, Solutions Architect, or relevant Amazon Connect certification

Success Profile
  
  

* Delivers cloud-native capabilities that measurably improve customer and agent experiences.
* Builds scalable, secure, and resilient integrations that extend Amazon Connect.
* Demonstrates understanding of customer journeys, contact center operations, and the consequences of service failures.
* Creates reusable AWS services and patterns that accelerate delivery across the Customer Experience Platform.
* Balances customer experience, delivery speed, operational reliability, security, cost, and long-term architectural integrity.
* Uses AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and innovation.
* Creates momentum by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions, and partnering across Connect, cloud, product, and operations teams.

* Proven expertise in query tuning and optimizing complex T-SQL code, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and high-volume OLTP workloads.

* Hands-on experience with AWS database technologies, including Amazon RDS for SQL Server, EC2, CloudWatch, IAM, and database migration initiatives from on-premises environments to AWS.
* Strong experience with High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Always On Availability Groups, database security, backup/recovery, and capacity planning.

title: Architect I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)
  
  
Location: UST Hyderabad
  
  
Type: Full time, in-house
  
  
**About The Role**
Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write
  
  
audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green
  
  
deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.
  
  
We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You
  
  
will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Architecture and roadmap
  
  

* Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.
* Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.
* Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.
  
  

* Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security
  
  

* Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).
  
  

* Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.
* Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate
  
  

* Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.
* Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.
* Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.
* Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.
  
  
Work with others
  
  

* Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.
  
  

* Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.
* Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.
  
  

* You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.
* You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical
  
  

* AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.
* Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.
* Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.
* Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.
* Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.
* Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working
  
  

* You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.
* You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.
* You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.
* Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.
* FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.
* Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like
  
  

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.
* Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.
* A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.
* The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.
* Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

**Skills**
AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

**Job Description:**

**Work Window:**

**Key responsibilities**

**Integration architecture and strategy**

•           Define the target integration architecture linking Veeva Vault (Clinical Operations, eTMF, CTMS, Study Startup, QualityDocs, RIM) with Snowflake and downstream systems.

•           Set integration standards: API-first patterns, event-driven and batch designs, error handling, monitoring and reusable components.

•           Maintain the integration roadmap in partnership with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory and Quality.

•           Veeva Vault and Snowflake delivery

•           Lead build of pipelines from Veeva Vault to Snowflake using Vault REST APIs, Vault Loader, Direct Data API, Vault Java SDK and Spark messaging.

•           Model clinical operations data in Snowflake (raw, curated and consumption layers) using Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, dbt and secure data sharing.

•           Integrate CROs, EDC (e.g. Medidata Rave, Veeva CDMS), IRT/RTSM, safety and finance systems with Vault and Snowflake.

•           Keep pipelines in step with Veeva's three general releases per year through regression testing and release impact reviews.

**AI-driven integration automation for CTMS**

•           Design and deploy AI and LLM solutions that automate CTMS data flows: document classification and metadata extraction for eTMF, site and milestone data mapping, and CRO data reconciliation.

title: Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth.com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook.
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through data-driven innovation? The Enterprise Data Platform team is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, evolution, and scaling of our AWS-based enterprise data platform that powers analytics, operational intelligence, AI-enabled solutions, and business-critical decision-making. This role is ideal for a technical leader who combines strong data engineering expertise with architectural vision, product thinking, and a passion for solving business problems through data. As a player-coach, you will contribute to architecture, technical design, and key implementations while mentoring engineers and shaping the future of our data platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business stakeholders to build scalable data products and platform capabilities that transform data into actionable insights, intelligent automation, and measurable business outcomes. Responsibilities
  
  
**Platform Architecture & Strategy**

* Architect and evolve scalable, secure, and AI-ready data platforms across ingestion, storage, transformation, analytics, and data product layers.
* Define technical vision, architecture standards, and engineering best practices that balance business needs, scalability, governance, and innovation. Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business teams to define and execute the architectural vision for a modern data platform, influencing long-term technical direction while balancing current priorities with future growth.
* Lead the evolution of our AWS-centric data platform by continuously evaluating modern data architecture patterns, cloud-native services, and emerging AI technologies to ensure the platform scales efficiently with growing business needs and data volumes.
* Assess build-versus-buy opportunities and make pragmatic technology decisions that balance business value, scalability, maintainability, operational complexity, and cost.
* Champion modern data architecture patterns including data products, data contracts, observability, self-service capabilities, metadata-driven architectures, and AI-assisted engineering practices.

**Data Products & Business Impact**


* Lead the design and delivery of data products that generate measurable business value through analytics, automation, AI/ML, and operational insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities and translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
* Apply a product mindset to data solutions, ensuring investments align with business priorities and user needs.
* Define success metrics and drive adoption, reliability, and business outcomes for data products.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the design and evolution of scalable data platforms and engineering practices that enable reliable delivery of data products across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases.
* Guide technology, architecture, and engineering decisions across the data ecosystem to ensure scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and long-term platform evolution.
* Establish engineering standards for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data platforms across batch, streaming, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and critical implementations.
* Promote engineering excellence through automation, testing, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as Code, and operational best practices.

**Team & Culture**

* Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers.
* Coach engineers in system design, architectural thinking, engineering craftsmanship, and operational excellence.
* Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical curiosity.

**Governance & Reliability**

* Ensure strong foundations in data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, security, and compliance.
* Drive platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence. Partner with security and governance teams to implement best practices for handling sensitive and regulated data.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related fields.
* 2+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and data products.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable business value through data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, automation, or a combination of these capabilities.
* Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, distributed data processing, and modern data platform technologies.
* Experience with technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Airflow, cloud-native services, and modern data engineering frameworks.
* Experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms on AWS, including data lake, data warehouse, orchestration, streaming, and analytics services.
* Experience with AWS technologies such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, IAM, Lake Formation, and related platform services.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, and drive platform modernization initiatives.
* Proven ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions and data products.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking, architectural leadership, and hands-on execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI-enabled data products and intelligent automation solutions.
* Experience applying machine learning, predictive analytics, Generative AI, or LLM-enabled capabilities to solve business problems.
* Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt. Experience with streaming and real-time data architectures.
* Experience leading modernization of AWS-based data platforms and evaluating emerging technologies to improve scalability, reliability, governance, and developer productivity.
* Experience with modern data stack technologies such as dbt, DataZone, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or similar ecosystem tools.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries. Experience working with HIPAA, GDPR, PII, or other regulated datasets. Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.

title: Data Engineering SMTS/LMTS
description:
**Description**
About Salesforce
  
  
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

title: Software Development Engineer (SE-III)

Software Development Engineer III (SDE-III)
  
  
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Development Engineer III will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling full-stack AI-powered systems that drive critical business workflows.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Software Development Engineer III is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning end-to-end full-stack solutions — from cloud-native backend services and APIs to modern front-end interfaces — built for scale, reliability, and performance. This role requires deep technical expertise across the stack, hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, and the ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies into production-grade engineering workflows. The Software Development Engineer III delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and the establishment of engineering best practices that raise the bar across the team.
* Contribute to a strong engineering culture by proactively sharing knowledge, championing code quality and observability standards, and supporting a collaborative, high-performance team environment.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and maintain highly reliable, performant systems that directly power the digital experiences fans interact with across Fanatics Commerce's global platform.
* Ensure solutions are designed with scalability and uptime in mind, minimizing disruption and delivering consistent, seamless fan-facing functionality.
* Translate business and product requirements into technical designs that keep the fan experience at the center of every architectural decision.
* Drive improvements to system observability and monitoring so that issues impacting fans are identified and resolved rapidly.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Evaluate and integrate the latest AI/ML tools and frameworks — including LLM-based agents, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI copilots — into product and engineering workflows to drive automation and efficiency.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and company-wide AI initiatives, and proactively bring relevant innovations into the team's roadmap.
* Architect and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM to build secure, scalable infrastructure.
* Identify and prototype new approaches to reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and unlock new capabilities for the business.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own the full software development lifecycle — design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — with an uncompromising focus on code quality, security, and reliability.
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and drive initiatives to resolve them before they impact the business.
* Operate with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, making sound technical decisions without waiting for direction.
* Consistently deliver complex, full-stack systems end-to-end with a track record of high-quality outcomes on time and at scale.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 4–5 years of professional software development experience with a strong track record of owning complex, full-stack systems end-to-end.
* Strong proficiency in backend development using languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Go, paired with hands-on experience in modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services spanning compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container orchestration (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM).
* Practical experience working with or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), or building AI-powered features and agents in production environments.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, SQL and NoSQL databases, caching strategies, and API design patterns (REST/GraphQL).
* Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and mentor other engineers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
On-site: Your work location will be onsite in
**Hyderabad, Telangana.**
Remote: As a fully remote role, the primary place of performance will be your residence or other approved remote location.
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in
**Hyderabad, Telangana**
, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence
**3 days per week**
.

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
**Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!**
**Who Are We?**
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!**
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
**In this role, You will..**
**Be Responsible For The Following**
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In This Position Your Main Mission Will Be**

* Engineering mission and leadership:

+ Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
+ As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.

* Platform Engineering:

+ Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
+ Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
+ Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
+ Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.

* Architecture and industrialization:

+ Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
+ Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team

* End-to-end delivery:

+ Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
+ Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.

* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:

+ Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
+ Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

**What are we looking for?**

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills

+ Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
+ Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
+ DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
+ Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
+ Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
+ Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
+ MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)

* Leadership style

+ Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
+ Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
+ Able to simplify without being simplistic
+ Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
+ Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs

* Mindset

+ You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
+ You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
+ You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
+ Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.

* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

**What’s In It for You?**

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

**Good to know: The Recruitment Process**

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Technical Lead

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-velocity Senior Technical Lead with an overall experience of 12+ years in software engineering who thrives in an environment of autonomy and rapid iteration. At Nomiso, we don't just write code; we build resilient systems. This role is designed for a builder who embraces our core philosophy: Build, Ship, Measure, Improve. You will be responsible for taking features from a raw concept to a live environment, ensuring that every deployment delivers high technical excellence and system stability. You are not just an executor; you are a technical owner and system architect who understands that the "Ship" is only the midpoint of the system lifecycle.

What We’re Looking For (Who You Are)

● AI Systems Architect (5+ years in AI - LLM, RAG, Context Engineering, ReAct, Prompt): You've shipped multiple production LLM systems at scale. Deep understanding of RAG, fine-tuning, prompt optimization, inference scaling, and cost management. You make pragmatic trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and cost.You are accountable for the high quality solution and timely shipment of the feature as per committed timeline.

● Technical Lead Manager (TLM): In this role you will do 70% technical work and 30% people management & project management work. You've led engineering teams (4-8+ engineers). You grow engineers through mentoring, clear feedback, and ownership. You balance shipping speed with technical excellence and team development.

● The "Builder" Mentality: You have a bias toward action. You prefer a working feature over a perfect specification and understand the value of getting software into the hands of users early. You will not leave the tech debt for a long time. Tech debt will be continuously addressed as product matures.

● Pragmatic Architect: You choose the right tool for the job, balancing long-term scalability with the immediate need for speed and delivery.

● Cross-functional engagement: Partner with Product, QA, and Solution Architects, Project manager to align execution with outcomes

● Continuous Learner: You view "Improvement" as a mandatory phase, not an optional one. You are eager to refactor and pivot based on objective evidence.

**Technical Stack & Qualifications**

**AI Expertise -**

● LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), model selection and trade-offs.

● RAG pipeline architecture, fine-tuning strategies, prompt engineering, Agentic patterns, multi step reasoning, reliability under uncertainty.

**Fullstack depth -**

● Backend: Python (FastAPI,

Django) and Node.js (Express,

Nest.js)

● Frontend: React (TypeScript,

state management, performance

optimization)

● Databases: PostgreSQL (query

optimization, schema design,

scaling)

● Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda,

ECS, RDS, S3), Docker, CI/CD,

monitoring

**Leadership -**

● Managed engineering teams (4-8+ engineers)

● Experienced mentoring and growing engineers

● Track record of building high - performing teams

● Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid decision - making

You will operate within a cross-functional squad, collaborating daily with Solution Architects and other engineering peers. You will ensure that features are released safely and frequently, and own the success of the product, by analysing the insights and user feedback. Our hierarchy is flat; you are expected to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior peers while having a direct line of communication with leadership regarding technical strategy and technical debt.

title: AI Solutions Expert
description:
**Job Title: AI Solution Expert**
**Location : Hyderabad**
**About The Company**
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.
  
  
This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Architect and lead AI-driven solutions that automate content creation, adaptation, review, approval, and distribution across all content channels and markets
* Build and maintain production-grade applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, and related platform services
* Integrate large language models, image generation models, video models, and multi-modal AI systems into scalable content workflows
* Design and implement data pipelines that connect AI models to enterprise content repositories, PIM systems, DAM platforms, and downstream delivery channels
* Drive initiatives through the full lifecycle — from POC through MVP to enterprise-scale deployment — establishing engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and governance at each stage
* Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, e-commerce, regulatory/legal, medical affairs, creative agencies, and IT to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem
* Define governance standards for AI model usage, data quality, content compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI practices
* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

**General Business**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering
* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services
* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks
* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures
* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation
* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)
* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)
* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns
* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC → MVP → enterprise production
* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production
* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)
* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**
**Cloud & AI Platform**
Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service
  
  
Data Engineering
  
  
Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks**
LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX
  
  
**Generative AI**
Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines
  
  
DevOps & MLOps
  
  
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML
  
  
**App Development**
REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures
  
  
**Security & Governance**
Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs
  
  
**General Business**
Languages: Python, TypeScript / JavaScript, SQL
  
  
Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.
  
  

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations
* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)
* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics
* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)
* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)
* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments
* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles
* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production
* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)
* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)
* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others
* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions
* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

What You’ll Impact.
  
  

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets
* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints
* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics
* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains
* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

**Why us?**
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
  
  
www.opella.com/en/careers

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About McDonald’s:**

One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.

Department Overview

McDonald’s new growth strategy, Accelerating the Arches, encompasses all aspects of our business as the leading global omni-channel restaurant brand. As the consumer landscape shifts, we are using our competitive advantages to further strengthen our brand. One of our core growth strategies is to Double Down on the 3Ds (Delivery, Digital and Drive Thru). McDonald’s will accelerate technology innovation so 65M+ customers a day will experience a fast, easy experience, whether at one of our 25,000 and growing Drive Thrus, through McDelivery, dine-in or takeaway.

Leading this revolution is McDonald’s Global Technology organization made up of intrapreneurs who get to build really cool tech with scary smart people using the latest innovations like AI, IOT, and edge computing. We do this working along diverse, global teams who are always hungry for a challenge. It’s bonus points when you get to see your family and friends use the tech you build at their favorite McD restaurant.

**Job Description**

This opportunity is part of the
**Global Technology Enterprise Products & Platforms (EPP) Team, focused**
**on Treasury and Tax applications, Kyriba and Vertex**
**,**
where our vision is to “Always be a people led, product centric, forward-thinking & trusted technology partner”.

The
**Solutions Architect**
role is responsible for designing and maintaining solutions blueprints for products and working with product engineering teams to implement solution design. This includes designing, configuring, and supporting implementation of innovative solutions that align with business objectives and technology strategy. This role will report to the Manager, Technical Product Management.

Duties

* Solution Design and Architecture
  + Work closely with stakeholders to understand their business objectives, challenges, and requirements.
  + Develop comprehensive architectural designs for technology solutions across multiple products that meet business requirements and integrate seamlessly with existing McDonald’s systems and platforms.
  + Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and resilient, in line with industry best practices and McDonald’s standards, aiming to strike a balance between innovation and stability.
  + Create and maintain architectural documentation, including high-level design and configuration documents, architecture diagrams and technical specifications.
  + Defines enterprise technical standards & ensures adherence.
  + Communicate these effectively to stakeholders, ensuring everyone understands the rationale behind architectural choices and their implications.
  + Plays pivotal role in design, development, testing and deployment of the overall solution. Experience working collaboratively in a predominantly supplier-enabled, outsource technology delivery environment.
  + Provides guidance and necessary clarifications to the boundary and integration systems and works with boundary and integration systems to troubleshoot and mitigate any source/destination issues and requirements. Perform root cause analysis with team.
  + Analyze Patches and plan patch deployment activities.

* Technology Strategy and Roadmap
  + Collaborate with product leadership teams to define and evolve the technology strategy and roadmap for the technology suite.
  + Identify emerging technologies and trends towards enhancing McDonald’s technology stack in the respective business area towards improving outcomes.
  + Provide guidance during evaluation and selection of new technologies, platforms and vendors.

* Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams
  + Foster collaboration with product managers, development teams, operations, security, and business units towards ensuring alignment between architectural vision and product development efforts.
  + Engage in regular communication and alignment meetings to ensure everyone is on the same page and working towards common goals.

* Implementation and Support
  + Oversee the implementation of architectural solutions and provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting for complex issues, ensuring timeline resolution and minimal disruption to operations.

* Governance and Compliance
  + Establish and enforce frameworks, policies and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and McDonald’s policies.
  + Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in IT systems and propose mitigation strategies.
  + Work with cybersecurity experts to ensure that systems are resilient against cyber threats and comply with relevant regulations and standards.

Qualifications

**Required :**

* 8+ years of experience in solution architecture, with focus on large-scale, global technology environments
* 3+ years in a multi-jurisdictional environment with emphasis in Indirect Tax
* Experience with Vertex or other tax engines a plus
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Deep understanding of Treasury applications and platforms as they relate between bank and client managing bank reporting and payment systems.
* Experience with cloud-native architecture.
* Demonstrated knowledge of large-scale integration in a QSR / Retail-like / Enterprise-Apps or BOS environment
* Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Strong knowledge of database technologies and data architecture principles
* Experience applying Product and Agile ways of working that includes best practices and lessons learned to standardize and refine ways of working.
* Highly experienced working collaboratively with business partners and product teams to drive outcomes and solve complex technical challenges, across a complex, global matrixed organization setup.
* Possess effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem solving and innovation skills to identify, develop, and make improvements to techniques, procedures, services, or products.
* Strong positive thinking skills that include creating a safe environment to learn, challenge, accept risk taking and a willingness to be wrong.
* Relevant industry certifications are a plus.

**Preferred :**

* Experience in operational aspects of banking systems as it relates to Oracle ERP.
* Knowledge of FTP/H2H connections, encryption/decryptions, certificate renewals, Bank/Kyriba/ERP APIs, Swift Protocols Fin/FileAct channels, etc.
* Experience in connectivity projects and migrations including bank connections and third parties’ integrations to our clients (sftp, API, certificate renewal, encryption…).
* Understanding of Cash Management, Cash Positioning and Forecasting, Liquidity Management, Payments and Payment Interfaces.
* Understanding of technical protocols such as TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, SSO, SAML 2.0, API a plus.
* Ability to provide thought leadership around Kyriba / Vertex Best practices and industry trends to drive optimization and improve end user experience.
* Evaluate project constraints to identify risks/gaps to the proposed technical solution.
* Understanding of integrations with Oracle EPM solutions with existing ERP systems and other enterprise applications.
* Proficiency with ITIL and Agile frameworks and tools (e.g. JIRA and Confluence)
* Experience in Creating and maintaining detailed technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and user manuals.
* Experienced implementing and managing IT General Controls (ITGC) to ensure SOX compliance.
* Foundational understanding/experience in security: security standards, SSO, SAML, OAUTH, etc.
* Understanding of Cloud architecture and EPM cloud security.
* Experience in DevOps, Security and Systems Performance desirable.

McDonald’s is the world’s leading global foodservice retailer with over 40,000 locations in over 100 countries. Approximately 95% of McDonald’s restaurants worldwide are owned and operated by independent local business owners. At McDonald’s, we lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community, and family. Here is your chance to get in on something special as we grow our corporate team in India and allow you to grow your career.

title: SAP BDC-DSP-Manager
description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

**<< What we look for>>**
We are looking for motivated professionals who are passionate about data, analytics, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, a continuous learning mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams to deliver business value through innovative SAP data and analytics solutions. They should be proactive, adaptable, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Security Architect II
description:
**Details:**
As a Security Architect and Engineer, you will lead the charge in fortifying our organization's security infrastructure. Your role encompasses designing and implementing robust security solutions tailored to our unique needs, ensuring that our systems, data, and networks remain resilient against potential threats. Collaborating closely with various stakeholders, you'll assess existing security frameworks, implement effective measures, and uphold stringent standards.
  
  
The individual will be a key member of the Architecture Review Board (ARB), helping ensure significant technology initiatives are evaluated for security, architecture, integration, operational impact, risk, and long-term supportability.
  
  
Your responsibilities extend beyond design, encompassing practical implementation and integration of security solutions into our existing infrastructure. You'll configure and deploy tools such as privileged identity management, secure cloud posture management, and secure application development technologies, AI controls, ensuring seamless integration while upholding rigorous security protocols.
  
  
****Architectural Security Design:****

* Develop and maintain architectural security standards, guidelines, and best practices.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient security architectures for various systems and applications.
* Identify, quantify, and provide design remediations for security risks as they relate to enterprise projects.
* Evaluate existing systems and propose enhancements to improve security posture.
* Partner with business members and IT leaders to drive security strategy and direction
* Produce management reporting, including appropriate metrics that inform senior leadership as to the state of information security risk and exposure
* Understands security product / service cost drivers and industry and business trends impacting the client information security program
* Provide information security matter expertise to technology teams and projects
* Ensure that the organization is leveraging the proper technologies to meet security related policies (including FTC, PCI)
* Ensure compliance with local regulations e.g. local encryption regulations and privacy law

**Architecture Review Board**

* Serve as a key technical member of the Architecture Review Board (ARB).
* Review significant technology initiatives and proposed architectural changes.
* Identify security concerns, dependencies, architectural impacts, operational considerations, and technical risks before implementation.
* Help teams evaluate alternative approaches and document architecture decisions.
* Improve the quality and consistency of technical information presented to the ARB.
* Help determine which initiatives require deeper security and architecture review. This aligns with prior internal discussion that Security should help evaluate projects against agreed standards and determine which should proceed through architecture review.

****Security Solution Implementation:****

* Implement security solutions based on industry standards and organizational requirements.
* Configure and deploy security tools, such as cloud security governance and monitoring, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection, and encryption mechanisms.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into new and existing systems.
* Recognizes and identifies potential areas where existing technical security polices standards and procedures require change, or where new ones need to be developed, especially regarding future business expansion
* Evaluate and recommend security software/hardware and its integration into existing architecture (Proof of Technology)

Job Requirements
  
  
**Details:**

* 10+ years equivalent work experience
* 3+ years experience as a security architect or consultant with enterprise experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaboration skills, and the ability to communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* In depth knowledge of information security practices related to PCI, SOX, FTC, and OWASP application security.
* Exhibit excellent analytical skills, the ability to manage multiple projects under strict timelines, as well as the ability to work well in a demanding, dynamic environment and meet overall objectives.
* Professional security management certification, such as a Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), AWS or Azure Certifications as related to security and architecture, Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or other similar credentials, is preferred.
* Knowledge of common information security management frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL, COBIT and ones from NIST and CIS are preferred.

****Technical Knowledge Areas:****

* Security Architecture Design : Ability to design secure, scalable, and resilient security architectures for various systems and applications including AI.
* Security Technologies : Proficiency in security tools and technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), SIEM, endpoint protection, encryption mechanisms, etc.
* Network Security : Understanding of network security principles, protocols, and technologies (e.g., VPN, SSL/TLS, IPsec, DNSSEC, SASE) inclusive of Zero Trust architecture
* Cloud Security : Knowledge of cloud security principles and experience with securing cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including identity and access management (IAM), data encryption, and secure configuration.
* Application Security : Familiarity with secure coding practices, web application firewalls (WAF), secure development life cycle (SDLC), and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Operating Systems : Proficiency in securing various operating systems, including Windows, Linux, and Unix.
* Encryption : Understanding of cryptographic principles and protocols, such as symmetric/asymmetric encryption, digital signatures, SSL/TLS, and PKI.
* Compliance : Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS) and experience in ensuring compliance with security regulations.
* Data Governance : Data Loss Prevention, File Integrity Monitoring, SEIM, Data scanning and tagging, Microsoft AIP

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Our Software Development Engineer provides software development support by analyzing business requirements to design and develop appropriate systems solutions according to specifications. They provide technical expertise in evaluating, designing, developing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting systems and procedures that are cost-effective and improve work efficiency. Additionally, the Software Development Engineer partners with Solution Architects to ensure that the application meets company service level standards and roadmap requirements.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities will include:**

* Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable systems, combining frontend development using React/Next.js with TypeScript and backend development with Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate) and additional backend languages like Node, Python, or Go.
* Backend Expertise with Java: Build high-performance, scalable backend systems using modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate). Ensure APIs, microservices, and integrations are robust, efficient, and secure.
* Cloud Services: Implement and maintain cloud-native applications on Azure or AWS, leveraging managed services such as computing, networking, databases (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), and object storage (e.g., S3, Azure Blob).
* Proficient in implementing robust testing strategies for Java applications using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Selenium, and Cucumber.
* Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven systems using tools such as Solace, Kafka, or AWS SNS/SQS, ensuring real-time communication and asynchronous workflows.
* DevOps & CI/CD: Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins, streamlining deployment processes.
