* Containerization & Orchestration: Develop and deploy scalable containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., AKS/EKS).
* AI-Driven Approaches: Improve products using AI tools, integrating AI-powered features such as predictive analytics or generative workflows into applications.
* Collaboration & Agile: Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment, offering reliable LOE (Level of Effort) estimates and technical recommendations.
* Production Support & Operations: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in production, ensuring solutions meet performance, reliability, and security standards.
* Analyze and translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into functional and non-function system requirements
* Design reliable/scalable/reusable/future-proof technical solutions to the business requirements/specifications/acceptance criteria and can effectively present your technical solutions to the review board in the format of POC or flow diagrams.
* Write technical design documents when needed and document complex solutions to share with your peers
* Work with solution architects to craft a technical solution that meets the company’s service level standard, security requirement and minimizes the dependency of the upstream teams and the impact to the downstream teams

**Other Responsibilities**

* Responsible for upholding F5’s Business Code of Ethics and for promptly reporting violations of the Code or other company policies.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What do you need to be successful in this role?**

* 6+ years building full-stack systems at scale
* Strong Experience in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, Go, Java
* Experience with responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
* Strong object-oriented programming skills.
* Hands-on experience with AWS (S3, DynamoDB, Aurora, Kinesis) and Azure (Blob Storage, CosmosDB, AKS). Proficient in utilizing compute, networking, and managed database solutions.
* CI/CD Tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates
* Experience automating deployments and streamlining workflows.
* Expertise in Docker containerization and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) for deploying and scaling applications.
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, CosmosDB
* Additional Tools: Redis (caching), Elasticsearch (search), Kafka (eventing)
* Production-ready experience with monitoring, logging, and ensuring security in distributed systems.
* Tools: Logging/monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
* Excellent communicator who translates product/customer needs into robust technical solutions.
* Leverages AI tools to boost team productivity — uses AI-assisted development and automation to create multiplier effects across the org.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
* Strong skills in communicating with different roles in a scrum team.
* Strong knowledge and working experience in object-oriented programming
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills

**Our values:**
At F5 we live and breathe our core values, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Customer Loyalty, Profitable Growth, Innovation, Employee Success, and Diversity. We help each other achieve our goals, value the diversity of ideas different backgrounds can bring, emphasize teamwork over rock-stars, work hard and most of all have fun

description:

Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, builds, automates, and supports secure, scalable, and resilient cloud platforms on AWS. This role partners with Cloud Operations, Information Security, DevOps, application engineering, database, and architecture teams to deliver reliable infrastructure and enable efficient software delivery. The position is accountable for AWS infrastructure engineering, Amazon EKS and container platforms, Terraform-based infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, cloud networking, security guardrails, observability, and operational readiness.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, implement, and support secure, scalable, highly available AWS cloud infrastructure that aligns with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
* Engineer and manage containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence across production environments.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, creating reusable modules, automation frameworks, and standardized deployment patterns that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
* Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and related DevOps tools to enable automated testing, security validation, deployment, and release management.
* Architect and support AWS networking solutions including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Route 53, VPN connectivity, and load balancing services to ensure secure and resilient connectivity.
* Implement cloud security controls, governance standards, and compliance requirements through IAM, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies (SCPs), KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud platform reliability through observability, incident response, root cause analysis, disaster recovery planning, backup strategies, and operational automation.
* Collaborate with Application Development, DevOps, Security, Database, and Cloud Operations teams to deliver cloud solutions, support modernization initiatives, establish engineering standards, and drive continuous improvement across the cloud platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of infrastructure, cloud engineering, or platform engineering experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience supporting enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Hands-on experience building and managing Kubernetes platforms, preferably Amazon EKS.
* Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of DevOps, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
* Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Experience supporting highly available, production-grade cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Include qualifications that would be beneficial but are not required for consideration.
  
  

* Experience implementing enterprise observability and monitoring solutions using Datadog, including infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring (APM), logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics.
* Experience designing and supporting AWS networking architectures utilizing Transit Gateway (TGW), Cloud WAN, Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, and hybrid-cloud connectivity solutions.
* Experience establishing API management standards using Amazon API Gateway, including authentication, authorization, throttling, monitoring, versioning, and security controls.
* Experience implementing and managing identity and access management solutions using Amazon Cognito, including User Pools, Identity Pools, federation, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and single sign-on (SSO) integrations.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
  
  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Number of Openings:**
2

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer with 4–5 years of hands-on experience managing, monitoring, securing, and optimizing AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day cloud operations, infrastructure provisioning, security, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and ensuring high availability across production and non-production environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Cloud Infrastructure Management – AWS and Azure**

* Manage AWS EC2 instances, EBS volumes, AMIs, Elastic IPs, Azure Virtual Machines, Managed Disks, and Storage Accounts.
* Configure and manage AWS ALB/NLB, Azure Load Balancer, and Azure Application Gateway.
* Manage AWS Auto Scaling Groups, scaling policies, launch templates, and Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets.
* Manage Amazon CloudFront, Azure Front Door, Route 53, and Azure DNS.
* Manage Amazon S3 and Azure Blob Storage, including lifecycle policies, versioning, backup, and recovery.

**2. Database Management**

* Manage and monitor Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, and Azure Database services, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL Database.
* Monitor database performance, CPU utilization, storage, connections, availability, and latency.
* Manage backups, snapshots, read replicas, high availability, maintenance, and recovery.
* Troubleshoot database connectivity and performance issues.

**3. Container Services – ECS, EKS, and AKS**

* Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot applications running on Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Manage container workloads, clusters, services, deployments, and Kubernetes resources.
* Manage Amazon ECR and Azure Container Registry (ACR).
* Monitor container health, deployments, resource utilization, and availability.

**4. Cloud Networking**

* Manage AWS VPCs and Azure Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, route tables, and network connectivity.
* Configure Security Groups, Network ACLs, Network Security Groups (NSGs), VPC Flow Logs, and Network Watcher.
* Manage Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, VPC endpoints, Azure NAT Gateway, and private endpoints.
* Configure and troubleshoot AWS Site-to-Site VPN, Azure VPN Gateway, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Troubleshoot network latency, routing, DNS resolution, and connectivity issues.

**5. Cloud Security**

* Manage AWS IAM roles and policies and Azure Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and managed identities.
* Configure AWS WAF, AWS Shield, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, and CloudTrail.
* Manage Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Firewall, Azure WAF, and Microsoft Entra ID security controls.
* Implement encryption, certificate management, least-privilege access, and security monitoring.
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security findings.

**6. Monitoring and Day-to-Day Operations**

* Perform daily monitoring of AWS and Azure infrastructure, including compute, databases, storage, networking, and container services.
* Monitor Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and application logs.
* Monitor CPU, memory, disk utilization, network traffic, database performance, load balancer health, and application availability.
* Configure alerts, dashboards, notifications, and monitoring reports.
* Investigate alerts, resolve performance issues, and maintain infrastructure availability.

**7. Incident Management and Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot infrastructure failures, high CPU utilization, connectivity issues, database problems, and application outages.
* Analyze CloudWatch logs, CloudTrail events, Azure Activity Logs, Azure Monitor logs, load balancer logs, and network flow logs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and coordinate with application, database, networking, and security teams.
* Participate in incident response, change management, and production maintenance activities.

**8. Backup and Disaster Recovery**

* Manage EBS snapshots, AMI backups, RDS backups, S3 lifecycle policies, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
* Validate backup completion and perform restoration and disaster recovery testing.
* Maintain backup retention, recovery procedures, and business continuity requirements.

**9. Performance and Cost Optimization**

* Optimize AWS EC2/RDS and Azure VM/database sizing and resource utilization.
* Review AWS Cost Explorer and Azure Cost Management to identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Recommend Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Azure Reservations, and storage optimization strategies.
* Identify idle resources and implement cost optimization without compromising availability or performance.

**10. Automation and Documentation**

* Automate routine operational tasks using AWS CLI, Azure CLI, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Work with AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and Azure infrastructure-as-code solutions.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and operational reports.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD and deployment automation.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of hands-on experience managing AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of EC2, EBS, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, S3, Route 53, RDS, Azure VMs, VNets, Storage Accounts, and Azure Load Balancing services.
* Experience with ECS, EKS, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, ECR, and ACR.
* Good understanding of cloud networking, IAM, Azure RBAC, WAF, GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and cloud security best practices.
* Hands-on experience with CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, alerting, troubleshooting, and incident management.
* Knowledge of Linux administration, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization.
* Familiarity with AWS CLI, Azure CLI, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, CI/CD tools, and production workload support.
* Experience supporting production workloads and participating in on-call support.
* Ensure reliable, secure, and efficient day-to-day AWS and Azure infrastructure operations.
* Proactively monitor infrastructure and resolve issues before they affect business services.
* Maintain high availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.
* Follow operational best practices and provide timely incident reports and RCA documentation.

Teach other engineers effective platform development and code review techniques

Help establish platform community practices around secure coding, data privacy, and design standards

Balance technical debt with platform evolution while maintaining enterprise reliability

Design systems that support business growth and can scale to enterprise demands

Work with data governance policies and master data management principles

Support technology modernization initiatives and legacy system transformation

Collaborate with enterprise architecture and security teams on strategic platform decisions

***Knowledge, Skills, Abilities***

Deep expertise in platform engineering, API design, and service-oriented architectures

Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Liquibase, SQL Server or Postgres, REST services with JSON payloads, Azure (e.g. API Management, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid), Redis and/or Snowflake is a plus.

Advanced understanding of cloud-native development, microservices, and distributed systems

Strong background in data architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and event-driven systems

Experience with performance optimization, scalability engineering, and system reliability

Knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, and modern deployment practices

Understanding of enterprise security, compliance, and regulatory requirements

Proven ability to drive architectural decisions and influence technical direction

Strong mentorship skills and experience leading complex technical initiatives

Ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, globally distributed engineering organization and communicate across technical and business teams

***Qualifications & Experience***

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

3-5 years of software engineering experience with significant platform engineering focus

Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale platform systems

Track record of leading complex technical initiatives and mentoring other engineers

Experience with regulated industries, preferably financial services

Strong background in API governance, data architecture, and enterprise integration

***Why Join AssetMark?***

Lead development of foundational platform capabilities that power the entire AssetMark ecosystem

Drive architectural decisions that shape the future of wealth management technology infrastructure

Work on transformational initiatives in a growth-oriented, private equity-backed environment

Mentor engineering talent and establish technical standards across the organization

Significant impact on technology strategy and platform evolution in the fintech space

***Our Commitment***

AssetMark values diversity of thought and background and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those who are traditionally underrepresented in technology.

Employment is subject to applicable local requirements and successful completion of AssetMark’s hiring process

description:
**Data Architect – Enterprise Data & AI Foundations**

**Hybrid to Hyderbad**

Full Time

**Role Summary**

Tachyon Technologies is looking for a hands-on Data Architect to design and lead enterprise data foundations for AI, analytics, automation, GenAI, and reporting use cases, mainly for Microsoft/Azure-based customers.

This role works with customers, business leaders, AI teams, and engineering teams. The Data Architect will assess the current data landscape, define the target-state architecture and roadmap, and set the standards for data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and AI-ready data layers. The person will own the architecture decisions and will also work hands-on during design, proofs of concept, and critical build phases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with customer business and technology stakeholders to understand business processes, AI use cases, analytics needs, and reporting requirements.
* Assess current data sources, platforms, data quality, integration gaps, and AI/analytics readiness, and present findings with recommendations.
* Define the target-state data architecture and a phased data foundation roadmap for AI and analytics programs.
* Design enterprise data platforms on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) layers, and curated data products.
* Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including dimensional models, canonical models, and semantic layers for Power BI.
* Set integration patterns for batch, near real-time, CDC, API-based, and event-driven ingestion from ERP, CRM, databases, files, APIs, and operational systems.
* Design data architecture for GenAI use cases, including RAG pipelines, document ingestion, chunking and embedding strategy, vector stores, and grounding data for copilots and AI agents.
* Define standards for data security, access control, privacy, metadata, cataloging, lineage, and governance, using tools such as Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog.
* Set frameworks for data quality, reconciliation, validation, error handling, observability, and pipeline monitoring.
* Make platform and tool choices (Fabric vs. Databricks vs. Synapse, storage formats, compute sizing) and keep cost, performance, and scalability in balance.

description:

**Job description**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Data Migration Engineer
  
  
**Summary**
The Data Migration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting data replication, migration, and integration solutions across cloud and on-prem environments. This role ensures secure, reliable, and high-performance data movement between heterogeneous systems, leveraging modern ETL tools, lakehouse technologies, and DevOps practices. The role carries platform and administration responsibilities for the Snowflake environment and the AWS data platform services that support it, and requires 24x7 operational support for mission-critical data pipelines.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Data replication and migration
  
  

* Design and implement data replication and migration solutions across multiple platforms (AWS DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, DB2, Snowflake).
* Develop and maintain ETL workflows using AWS services (DMS, Glue) and other integration tools.
* Ensure data integrity, latency, and SLA compliance for replication and migration processes.
* Plan and execute migrations off legacy on-prem estates into AWS, including validation, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning.
* Provide 24x7 support for data replication platforms, including incident management and root cause analysis.
* Monitor and optimize replication performance, ensuring scalability and cost efficiency.

Platform and DevOps engineering
  
  

* Build and operate data platform services on AWS, including AWS Glue (ETL jobs, crawlers, Data Catalog), AWS Lambda, S3, Step Functions, and EventBridge.
* Develop and maintain lakehouse ingestion patterns using Apache Hudi (upserts, incremental processing, compaction, clustering, schema evolution), with awareness of comparable open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* Implement DevOps practices for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation), including automated testing and promotion between environments.
* Deploy and support Windows and Linux compute in AWS (EC2, clustering, networking, IAM) in support of replication and migration workloads.
* Implement observability across the platform: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboarding (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).

Snowflake administration
  
  

* Administer the Snowflake platform as day-to-day operational owner: account, database, schema, and warehouse management.
* Design and manage role-based access control (RBAC), including role hierarchies and integration with enterprise identity (SSO/SCIM).
* Manage warehouse sizing, auto-suspend/auto-resume, resource monitors, and query optimization to control cost and performance.

* Implement platform governance: data masking, row access policies, tagging, time travel/retention configuration, and usage monitoring.
* Establish and maintain runbooks, standards, and documentation for Snowflake administration, and support knowledge transfer across the team.

Security, governance, and collaboration
  
  

* Maintain compliance with security standards, including encryption in transit and at rest, IAM roles and policies, and vulnerability management.
* Collaborate with architecture and security teams to validate designs and ensure adherence to governance policies.
* Partner with business units and vendors (including vendor engineering/professional services teams) to deliver strategic data integration solutions.

* Minimum 3 years in data replication, migration, and integration engineering.
* Hands-on experience with AWS Data Migration Service (DMS), AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and S3-based staging for Snowflake.
* Practical experience with Apache Hudi or a comparable open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake) in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of Snowflake architecture and administration: RBAC, warehouse and cost management, bulk loading (COPY INTO), and Snowpipe.
* Proficiency in PostgreSQL, DB2, and other relational databases.
* Experience migrating or re-platforming legacy Windows Server workloads into cloud environments.

Programming & Automation
  
  

* Scripting skills in Python and Shell; PySpark experience advantageous.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Docker).

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Understanding of TLS/SSL, encryption standards, IAM policies, and vulnerability management.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience with ETL/replication tools (Qlik Replicate, Matillion, Fivetran) is a plus.
* Knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Experience supporting the handover or transition of platform services between teams.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

**Other Requirements**

Novartis architecture principles call for AI adoption guided by business value: AI is evaluated for new solutions and enhancements wherever it delivers a clear benefit, and it must be delivered on infrastructure that is secure, compliant and economically sustainable. Within Cloud & Hosting Services, AI & HPC Engineering is the single product management and delivery channel for AI infrastructure and AI use-case onboarding. The AI Infrastructure Architect sets the architecture those platforms are built to.
  
  
The role defines the reference architecture and guardrails for AI workloads across Azure, AWS and private AI environments: training and inference platforms, GPU capacity and scheduling, data pipelines and data access, model operations, logging, monitoring, cost control and lifecycle governance. It establishes the standard intake pattern by which an AI use case moves from idea to a hosted, monitored, auditable service, so that scientists and business teams get speed without the organisation inheriting uncontrolled risk.
  
  
This is an individual contributor architecture role. Its authority comes from design quality, evidence and adoption rather than from line management.

* Own the AI infrastructure reference architecture and the standards that govern training, fine-tuning, inference and retrieval-augmented patterns across public cloud and private AI hosting.

title: Associate Director - HPC Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Summary**
Scientific computing sits at the centre of how Novartis discovers and develops medicines. Cloud & Hosting Services has established AI & HPC Engineering as the single engineering and delivery channel for high-performance computing, and Architecture & Integration owns the target architecture behind it. The HPC Infrastructure Architect is accountable for that architecture: the compute, storage, interconnect, scheduling and data-locality design that scientific workloads run on, on premises and in the cloud.
  
  
The role translates scientific demand - molecular modelling, imaging and cryo-electron microscopy, genomics, simulation and increasingly AI-adjacent workloads - into capacity models, workload placement principles and platform patterns. It carries the physical dependencies with it: power, rack and cooling envelopes, high-performance storage tiers, network fabric, and the data centre and colocation footprint that a large campus and site transformation programme is reshaping.
  
  
This is an individual contributor architecture role in which credibility with scientists matters as much as credibility with infrastructure engineers.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the HPC reference architecture: cluster topologies, CPU and GPU node designs, high-performance and tiered storage, interconnect fabric, schedulers and the software stack that supports scientific workflows.
* Define the scientific workload placement model - which workloads run on dedicated clusters, which burst to cloud, and which belong on AI platforms - based on performance, data gravity, cost and compliance.
* Produce and maintain capacity plans for compute, accelerators, storage and network, including the power, rack and cooling requirements that data centre and colocation planning depends on.
* Establish data-locality and data-movement principles across instruments, laboratories, storage tiers, archive and cloud, including replication and recovery approaches for irreplaceable scientific data.
* Translate scientific requirements into sizing, benchmarking and procurement input, and validate feasibility before engineering build.
* Maintain architecture decision records for HPC platform choices, connecting each to scientific outcome, cost and lifecycle consequence.
* Define the interface with AI infrastructure so that shared accelerators, storage and data pipelines are used coherently rather than duplicated.
* Ensure HPC designs meet security, quality and regulatory expectations and are operable by Infrastructure Operations after handover.
* Engage scientific communities and research IT partners as the trusted architecture contact for high-performance computing.
* Coach engineers and analysts, and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.

**Essential Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience designing, building, or operating large-scale High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments.
* Proven expertise in HPC platform architecture, capacity planning, and multi-cluster infrastructure design.
* Strong experience supporting Linux-based compute clusters in enterprise or scientific computing environments.
* Hands-on knowledge of workload schedulers such as Slurm, LSF, or comparable HPC scheduling technologies.
* Solid understanding of CPU and GPU infrastructure design, performance optimization, and benchmarking methodologies.
* Experience with high-performance storage solutions, parallel file systems, and high-speed networking technologies, including InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics.
* Knowledge of containerized, reproducible scientific workflows and hybrid or cloud-based HPC environments.
* Familiarity with large-scale data management practices, including data replication, archiving, and infrastructure planning (power, cooling, and rack design); experience supporting research or scientific computing communities is highly desirable.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Able to work fluently with scientists and translate research needs into infrastructure terms; rigorous, evidence-based approach to sizing and benchmarking; long-horizon planning discipline; strong collaboration across engineering, facilities and research organizations.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Additional languages are an asset.

The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high-performance N-tier system.
  
  
You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.

**Technical Requirements**
Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti-pattern). Frontend Expert-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C# and .NET (6/7/8/9+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
  
  
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Modernization Veteran: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years specifically leading Legacy-to-Modern migration projects.
* The "2-to-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:
**Job Description**
**Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations**
**Summary/Objective**
The Sr. Manager, Data & Integrations is the people leader and delivery owner for isolved's India-based data and integrations personnel. This role is fluent across both sides of the house: on the data side, this person needs to operate at the same architectural depth expected of isolved's Principal Data Architect, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling, data lineage, integrity, and governance, alongside hands-on fluency in Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch; and on the integrations side (system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, with deep API understanding, source and target schema design, master data management, and golden record configuration and management). This person owns hiring, coaching, and performance management for all India personnel on the data and integrations teams, and partners closely with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones so that the India team operates as a fully integrated extension of isolved's global data and integrations organization.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary people leader for all India-based personnel on the data and integrations teams, spanning data platform, data engineering, and integration automation disciplines.
* Conduct 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to support the growth of the India team.
* Hire, onboard, and build a high-performing, collaborative India-based data and integrations organization.
* Set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, and address performance issues effectively.
* Partner with U.S.-based counterparts, including the Manager, Data & Analytics Engineering and the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, to coordinate workload distribution, execution, and planning across time zones.
* Ensure consistent standards, practices, and quality bar between the India and U.S. data and integrations teams.
* Own delivery of system-to-system data integrations, ideally built on Workato, including source and target schema design and mapping between isolved and its ecosystem of ERP, CRM, and partner systems.
* Own master data management and golden record configuration and management practices for the India team's scope of work, applying matching, deduplication, and survivorship standards.
* Maintain deep, working knowledge of APIs, including how to design, secure, and structure them for reliable, scalable, automated execution.
* Oversee data platform and analytics engineering work in India, including administration and support of Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, and Hightouch.
* Own data architecture standards for the India team's scope of work, including medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views, in partnership with the Principal Data Architect.
* Own data lineage, integrity, and cleanliness standards for India-delivered data work, and ensure the team applies data governance and cataloging practices (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation) consistently with global standards.
* Apply data quality and testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests) to catch and resolve data issues before they reach downstream consumers.
* Ensure the India team's data pipeline work spans the full lifecycle, from ingestion through transformation, storage, and downstream consumption, including batch and, where appropriate, real-time/streaming patterns.
* Factor data lifecycle, retention, archival, and storage/compute cost optimization into architecture and delivery decisions.
* Maintain expert-level fluency in SQL and strong hands-on fluency in PySpark, sufficient to review, guide, and, when needed, directly contribute to complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Track and balance capacity and workload across the India team, coordinating handoffs and shared work with U.S. shifts to keep delivery continuous across time zones.
* Represent the India team in global roadmap, planning, and prioritization discussions, bringing India-specific context and constraints into those conversations.
* Serve as an escalation point for production data and integration issues originating from or affecting the India team, coordinating incident response with U.S. counterparts as needed.
* Promote adoption of AI-assisted development and automation tools, and establish metrics to improve engineering productivity and delivery reliability.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architecture, security, integrations, and analytics stakeholders in both India and the U.S. to ensure platform effectiveness and data integrity.

**Job Complexity**
Works on issues of significant scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including cross-regional business and operational considerations. Establishes objectives and work plans for the India data and integrations organization, and exercises judgment in adapting global standards and priorities to local execution. Erroneous decisions or judgment could result in delays in schedules and may impact the overall success of the function. Develops and administers schedules, staffing plans, and performance requirements for the India team; may have budget responsibilities.
  
  
**Interaction**
Frequently interacts with senior management, functional peer group managers, and cross-regional counterparts in the U.S. and India, normally involving matters between functional areas, regions, or business units. Regularly leads a cooperative effort among India and U.S. team members to align on priorities, execution, and planning across time zones.
  
  
**Supervision**
Manages the coordination of the activities of the India data and integrations organization, with responsibility for results, including costs, methods, and staffing. Understands management practices, particularly around professional development and cross-regional team coordination, and is skilled at handling difficult management situations independently.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of direct experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or integration engineering, with 4+ years of people management experience, including experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  
  

* 8-10+ years of professional experience spanning both data engineering/data platform work and systems integration work.
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Proven experience managing distributed or cross-regional teams, ideally coordinating with U.S.-based counterparts across time zones.
* Well-versed in both the data side of the house (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch) and the integrations side of the house (system-to-system data integrations, ideally with Workato).
* Principal-level depth on the data architecture side: strong understanding of medallion architecture, data mesh, dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas), data cubes, and materialized views.
* Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with PySpark, sufficient to guide and review complex data engineering and data architecture work.
* Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., Microsoft Purview) and data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
* Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse platform and Airflow or equivalent tooling for pipeline orchestration.
* Experience with data sharing technologies and patterns (e.g., Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing), including the governance and access considerations they require.
* Understanding of data lifecycle management, retention/archival policies, and storage/compute cost optimization.
* Deep understanding of APIs, including designing, securing, and structuring them for reliable, automated execution.
* Strong understanding of source and target schema design and mapping for system-to-system integrations.
* Experience with master data management and golden record configuration and management, including matching, deduplication, and survivorship logic.
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

title: Software Development Manager, DSP Tech
description:
**Description**
Do you want to lead the team that transforms how safety decisions are made for Amazon's Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across 21 countries? Are you passionate about building intelligent, data driven platforms that protect delivery associates every single day?
  
  
DSP SafetyTech is a newly formed team serving as the intelligence layer between safety signals and decisions — interpreting what happened, routing it to who can act, and ensuring no safety event goes unresolved. Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of SDEs, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will own three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces (Scorecard, ORCAS, notifications); and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents embedded in the DSP Portal that provide actionable safety insights.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build a team and platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and grow a cross functional team of software engineers and data engineers to deliver across multiple strategic themes
* You can effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to tech and non tech audiences
* You have experience with architecting systems involving data processing components, workflow orchestration and dependency management
* Architect and deliver a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems into a single trusted source
* Own the design and delivery of a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed, replacing multiple fragmented config surfaces
* Drive development of compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators
* Lead frontend and backend development of a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together
* Partner with upstream platform teams to integrate sensing and signal fusion capabilities, positioning the team as the distribution and applied science layer
* Drive development of AI powered agents that make safety intelligence accessible to partners in plain language

title: Principal Data Architect - Multi-Cloud (GCP & Azure)
description:
We are seeking a Principal Data Architect to define and drive enterprise data architecture, modernization, and governance strategies across complex multi-cloud (Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure) and hybrid environments. This role will design scalable, secure, and high-performing data platforms while partnering with business and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into impactful data solutions.
  
  
A key focus of this role will be spearheading scalable, agent-driven data migration pipelines to transition legacy on-premises data assets to the cloud, setting the technical direction for engineering teams, and actively managing the customer's technical backlog and delivery roadmap.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Cloud Lakehouse Architecture: Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of scalable Data Lakehouse solutions across Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, GCS, BigLake, Dataplex) and Microsoft Azure (Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks).
* On-Prem to Cloud Migration & Agentic Pipelines: Architect and deploy automated, scalable, agent-driven data pipelines (leveraging GenAI agents and metadata-driven frameworks) to orchestrate, validate, and accelerate complex migrations from on-premises legacy warehouses/databases (Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server) to GCP and Azure.
* Client Engagement & Advisory: Collaborate directly with customers to understand business goals, data challenges, and technical requirements; translate them into robust architectural blueprints, technical roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Customer Technical Backlog Management: Own and actively manage the customer technical backlog—translating business epics into technical user stories, prioritizing technical debt, defining sprint milestones, and aligning backlog items with business ROI.
* Modern Ingestion & Streaming: Design and implement data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch ingestion using modern orchestration (Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory, Airflow) and streaming/messaging frameworks (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs).
* Governance & Lineage: Establish and enforce best practices for unified data cataloging, metadata management, automated lineage, and data quality across multi-cloud and on-prem systems using Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, or open-source governance tools.
* Security & Compliance: Define and implement robust data security, identity management (IAM / Azure Entra ID), encryption, row/column-level access control, and regulatory compliance standards across clouds.
* Team Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Steer the overarching technical direction of engineering teams; establish architectural standards, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct architecture review, and ensure engineering excellence.
* Hands-on Delivery & Prototyping: Balance strategic architecture discussions with hands-on solutioning, architectural spikes, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), and performance tuning of complex multi-cloud distributed workloads.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with enterprise architects, delivery leads, DevOps engineers, and customer stakeholders to drive solution adoption, operational scalability, and long-term platform maintainability

**Technical Experience & Tooling**
Candidates should demonstrate hands-on architecture and design experience across the following domains:
  
  

* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in both Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure enterprise data ecosystems.
* Processing Engines: Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric Spark, GCP Dataproc.
* Modern Migration & AI Automation: Building automated, agentic, or metadata-driven data migration pipelines, automated schema conversion, and data validation agents for on-prem to cloud lift-and-shift/re-platforming.
* Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs.
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Google Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Analytical Storage & Warehouses: GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake/Parquet.
* NoSQL / Cache Storage: MongoDB, Redis, Bigtable, Azure Cosmos DB.
* Containerization & Deployment: Kubernetes (GKE and AKS), Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps.
* API Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Flask) for data service endpoints.
* Databases & Querying: Advanced SQL validation and extraction from legacy/RDBMS systems (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL).
* CI/CD & Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data Platform architecture.
* 5+ years architecting, migrating, and deploying production data platforms across GCP and/or Azure, with proven multi-cloud integration patterns.
* Demonstrated track record leading on-premises/cloud to cloud modernization/migration initiatives, including data ingestion, transformation, automated data reconciliation, and cutover strategies.
* Experience designing or integrating autonomous, agent-driven, or LLM-augmented data workflows (e.g., automated schema mapping, code conversion, data quality validation agents).
* Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying Lakehouse platforms incorporating Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and Data Mesh / Data Product principles.
* Deep knowledge of multi-cloud data governance, access management, and cataloging (Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
* Strong leadership capability in technical backlog management, agile scoping, sprint planning, and setting technical strategy for distributed teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder communication skills: capability to articulate architectural trade-offs to C-level executives as smoothly as reviewing code with engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications (Optional / Good To Have)**

* Multi-cloud certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect and/or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate / Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and Databricks
* Familiarity with AWS data services (Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR).
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agentic framework integrations in data operations.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

The Director, Core Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, and continuous improvement of Nationwide’s core infrastructure capabilities in India. The successful candidate combines strong technical judgment with a positive, people-centered leadership style. * Ensure operational processes and technical solutions support Nationwide’s risk-management, governance, and audit expectations.

* Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

+ Present service performance, technology risks, transformation initiatives, financial metrics and improvement opportunities to executive audiences.
+ Act as the voice of the customer internally and ensure strong alignment between customer expectations and delivery teams.
+ Own the overall customer relationship and proactively address risks that could impact customer satisfaction, retention or revenue.
+ Build executive-level relationships that support long-term account growth and strategic partnership.

* Strategic Cloud Advisory & Architecture Governance


+ Provide strategic architectural oversight across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
+ Advise customers on cloud adoption, modernization, migration and cloud-native transformation.
+ Drive adoption of Well-Architected, reliability engineering, security-by-design and automation-first principles.
+ Lead cloud maturity assessments and develop multi-year technology transformation roadmaps.
+ Identify opportunities for application modernization, platform engineering, automation and operational simplification.
+ Provide guidance on high availability, resilience, disaster recovery, scalability and capacity planning.
+ Partner with enterprise architects and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions align with business objectives.

* OEM & Technology Ecosystem Management


+ Maintain a strong understanding of OEM technology portfolios, product capabilities, licensing models, support models and professional/managed service offerings.
+ Understand the positioning and value proposition of major OEMs across cloud, compute, storage, networking, security, databases, backup, DR, observability and enterprise applications.
+ Evaluate OEM solutions against customer requirements and recommend appropriate technology and service options.
+ Engage with OEMs and technology partners to leverage their technical expertise, support capabilities, professional services and commercial programs.
+ Identify opportunities to combine OEM solutions with managed services to create differentiated customer propositions.
+ Stay current with changes in OEM product roadmaps, licensing models, cloud marketplace offerings and technology trends.
+ Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams in developing technology solutions, proposals and account expansion strategies.

* Service Governance & Operational Excellence


+ Govern SLA, KPI and OLA performance across CloudOps, SRE, DevOps, Security and Platform Engineering teams.
+ Establish and drive continuous service improvement initiatives.
+ Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Management.
+ Lead major incident and escalation management, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and root-cause resolution.
+ Review operational trends and proactively identify service risks before they impact the customer.
+ Govern disaster recovery readiness, business continuity, capacity management and operational resilience.
+ Drive automation and proactive monitoring to reduce recurring incidents and manual operational effort.
+ Establish service improvement plans with measurable outcomes and executive visibility.

* FinOps, P&L, Revenue & Commercial Management


+ Demonstrate strong understanding of FinOps principles, practices and operating models across cloud environments.
+ Drive cloud financial management covering cost visibility, allocation, optimization, forecasting, budgeting and governance.
+ Identify opportunities to optimize cloud consumption and improve customer technology economics without compromising performance, security or resilience.
+ Own or contribute significantly to the P&L performance of assigned customer accounts or service portfolios.
+ Manage account-level revenue, gross margin, cost base and profitability in partnership with business and finance teams.
+ Own revenue management and forecasting, including actuals, run-rate revenue, pipeline, renewals and growth opportunities.
+ Monitor account financial performance and proactively address revenue leakage, margin erosion and cost overruns.
+ Identify opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, expansion and transformation-led revenue growth.
+ Partner with Sales, Finance and Delivery teams to develop account growth and profitability plans.
+ Ensure services are delivered within agreed commercial and financial parameters.

* Billing, Collections & Revenue Assurance


+ Own governance of the customer billing lifecycle, ensuring accurate, timely and complete invoicing.
+ Ensure billing is aligned with contracts, statements of work, consumption, SLAs, milestones and agreed pricing models.
+ Proactively identify and resolve billing disputes, revenue leakage and invoicing discrepancies.
+ Partner with Finance, Accounts Receivable and Delivery teams to improve billing accuracy and collection performance.
+ Monitor outstanding receivables, disputed invoices and payment risks for strategic accounts.
+ Establish governance mechanisms to minimize billing delays and improve DSO / cash realization.
+ Ensure changes in scope, consumption, resources and service levels are appropriately reflected in commercial and billing processes.

* Customer Retention & Account Growth


+ Take accountability for customer retention and account health across assigned strategic accounts.
+ Establish early-warning mechanisms to identify customer dissatisfaction, service risks and competitive threats.
+ Develop and execute customer recovery and retention plans where required.
+ Track customer satisfaction, executive engagement, service performance and commercial health.
+ Build multi-year customer relationships and position the organization as a strategic technology partner.
+ Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through cloud transformation, modernization, security, automation and managed services.
+ Partner with Sales and Account Management to develop and execute account growth strategies.

* Leadership & Cross-Functional Orchestration


+ Lead and coordinate cross-functional technology teams to deliver seamless customer outcomes.
+ Orchestrate activities across Cloud Operations, Architecture, Security, DevOps, SRE, Service Management, Finance and Engineering.
+ Mentor and coach junior TAMs, service delivery managers and technical leaders.
+ Collaborate closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Enterprise Architecture, Product, Finance and Delivery leadership.

+ Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with CIO, CTO, CISO and other CXO-level stakeholders.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise cloud architecture, operations, security, reliability and governance.

title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Manages the activities of a team of data analysts and newer data engineers responsible for developing software code that formats, tags, processes, stores and serves data. Manages the development of data pipelines to ensure that they are scalable, repeatable, and secure and can serve multiple groups at Vanguard.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, Data Engineering is responsible for leading a team of data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role focuses on enabling high-performance data workflows, ensuring seamless data integration and driving automation to enhance data accessibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Define and execute data engineering strategy, architecture, and roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise data objectives.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integration frameworks, and cloud-native data platforms.
* Drive the development of data warehouses, lakehouse solutions, data products, and analytical platforms that support enterprise reporting and insights.
* Establish standards for data quality, governance, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Partner with data science, analytics, product, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions.
* Ensure data platforms are secure, resilient, performant, and compliant with enterprise technology standards.
* Champion automation, DevOps practices, and modern engineering methodologies to improve delivery efficiency and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership for evaluating and adopting emerging technologies and data engineering best practices.
* Manage delivery planning, stakeholder communications, risk management, and execution of strategic data initiatives.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing data engineering teams and large-scale data infrastructure.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT, or a related field or Diploma in Data Science/Data Engineering.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data products.
* Strong expertise in ETL/ELT development, data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PySpark, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka, and modern data engineering frameworks.
* Experience building cloud-native data solutions utilizing AWS and Databricks technologies.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security, and operational monitoring.
* Experience working within Agile delivery models and leading cross-functional technology teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services including S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis, Athena, and Redshift.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Knowledge of Data Mesh, Data Products, Semantic Modeling, and Metadata Management.
* Experience with business intelligence and analytics platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Exposure to AI-enabled data platforms and Agentic AI solutions.
* Financial services or other regulated industry experience.
* Experience leading enterprise data transformation initiatives and globally distributed engineering teams

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

****Job Description****
**Specialist, Infrastructure Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. * Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the Product manager.
* Participate in Product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with Product goals.

****What Should You Have****

* 3-7 years of hands-on experience.

* Knowledge of building out ServiceNow CMS (ESS – Employee Self Service Portal).
* Strong knowledge of Agile delivery & practice.
* Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL or other).
* Good communication skills.
* Flexibility to work a shift overlapping part of the US Work Day.
* Previous experience with the development of automated testing solutions.
* Working knowledge of AWS serverless architecture including the use of Lambdas and step functions.

****Preferred Skills****
**Primary Skills**
**(Must have)**

* Strong hands-on experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
* Experience with Git and version control best practices.
* Experience in Full Stack Application Development.
* Working knowledge of Cloud Technologies (AWS preferred; Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platforms acceptable).
* Experience working with Databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, or similar.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Ability to design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain scalable web applications.

* Knowledge of ServiceNow Flow Designer and workflow development.

Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities. We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP CPI-PI Consultant**
SAP CPI Consultant will be responsible for custom interface design/development while adhering to established processes and simultaneously handling critical situations. Candidate will be willing to take up challenges, understand key business areas, propose alternatives and suggestions to make solution sustainable, and develop competency for the team. He/she will have the skills required to become a successful technical architect and be part of complex global implementations. Moreover, features that can transfigure an individual’s potential to upraise an organization to the next level is imperative.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a developer you will be expected to design/develop end to end interfaces across different process areas.
  
  
Being a CMMI certified organization there is a major focus on the quality of the deliverables. The developer will be expected to complete all the required documentation during the build phase and also take care of review activities including self-review and peer review. Primary job functions include:
  
  

* Functional specification reviews
* Preparation of technical specification
* Translating technical specification to Interfaces
* Technical unit testing
* Documentation
* Tracking timesheets
* Using project management tools – as trained
* Interacting with functional teams for issue resolution
* Capturing MOM during technical review meetings

SAP Service Line at Deloitte is one of the largest and most experienced SAP integrators in the world with 8000 global SAP practitioners. Our SAP practice has executed more than 1,700 SAP implementation projects worldwide. More than 50% of our SAP consultants have 10+ years of SAP implementation experience. Deloitte has held the highest level of strategic alliance designated by SAP, Global Partner — Services, since 1989.We have nine solution centers for SAP demos, research, and outsourcing and also have developed a number of proprietary tools and accelerators that contribute significantly to our ability to help our clients compress project timelines and deliver high quality SAP services. Our SAP Practice offers a complete range of implementation services — from business case development and system design to configuration, testing and deployment. Our SAP delivery capabilities are accessed at CMMI level 5 and SAS 70 certification. Learn more about Deloitte Consulting.

description:
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim,
  
  
Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 650 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  
Job Title: Oracle Sales Cloud Security – Sr. Analyst - Applications
  
  
Experience: 6+ Years on Oracle Cloud Security
  
  
Location: Hyderabad & Bangalore
  
  
Working Hours: 12:00pm to 9.00pm
  
  
**Responsibilities**

The Oracle Cloud Security – Sr Analyst – Applications role is responsible to support and lead Oracle security initiatives from the Global Capability Centre (GCC). This role is dedicated to Oracle Cloud and Application Security workloads, responsible for designing, implementing, and governing secure Oracle environments aligned with Clean Harbors’ enterprise security and compliance standards. **Compliance & Risk Management**

* Perform security risk assessments, segregation of duties (SoD) analysis, and remediation.
* Partner with audit, compliance, and internal security teams during audits.

* Ensure data protection, encryption, and secure data flow between Oracle and external systems.

* Experience supporting audit, SOX compliance, and risk controls
* Knowledge of Oracle integrations, OIC, and API security
