title: Senior Specialist, MEEHS Solution Architecture
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health & Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build-versus-buy options, guide proof-of-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the MEEHS target architecture Develop current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital-thread capabilities Conceptualize and assess digital-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine-learning use cases, and future agent-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance Incorporate secure-by-design, least-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.

**What You Should Have**
**Primary Skills**
**TOGAF**

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
* Enterprise System Integration

**AI/Machine Learning Architecture**

* Secondary Skills CAD/BIM Platforms (Autodesk, Bentley)
* CMMS / Asset Reliability Platforms
* EHS Platforms (Enablon, Sphera, Cority, Intelex)
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of IT experience, including substantial experience in system architecture, solution architecture, enterprise integration, application modernization, and data-platform design.
* Demonstrated experience creating solution, integration, application, data, cloud, security, and deployment architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* Experience designing interoperability across COTS, SaaS, vendor-hosted, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise platforms using reusable integration and information patterns.
* Experience architecting data hubs, data platforms, warehouses, lakes or lakehouses, semantic models, metadata and lineage capabilities, data quality controls, and governed analytical consumption.
* Experience progressing concepts from discovery and feasibility assessment through proof of concept, pilot, implementation, rollout, operational transition, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, infrastructure, integration, data and analytics, procurement, service management, vendors, and managed service teams.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Architecture methods and modeling Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability API-first and event-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project-to-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.
* Analytics and AI enablement Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms, analytical data preparation, feature-ready datasets, vector and semantic retrieval concepts, knowledge graphs, responsible AI controls, data provenance, model monitoring, and human oversight.
* Cybersecurity and identity Zero Trust, secure-by-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA+ data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.

**Non-Technical Skills And Competencies**

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Ability to facilitate discovery, architecture workshops, trade-off decisions, design reviews, feasibility assessments, and cross-functional alignment using clear decision criteria.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.

**Working Hours and Expectations**

* This is primarily an office-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.
* Participate in planned architecture workshops, proof-of-concept activities, releases, cutovers, disaster-recovery exercises, and occasional off-hours support for critical implementation or production events in accordance with established procedures.
* Occasional travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, project teams, vendor engagements, architecture workshops, or implementation activities.

**Performance Measures**

* Delivery of approved current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures, reference patterns, architecture decisions, implementation roadmaps, and technical work packages aligned with agreed scope and outcomes.
* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
* Progress in establishing central data hubs with trusted ingestion, transformation, metadata, lineage, quality, semantic modeling, access, and consumption capabilities.
* Business acceptance and measurable use of governed data for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and prioritized AI use cases.
* Feasibility assessments and architecture recommendations that provide clear options, trade-offs, dependencies, cost and risk considerations, and executable next steps.
* Compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, GMP/GxP, validation, data integrity, records, operational resilience, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Reduction of duplicate integrations, fragmented data flows, unsupported technologies, manual reconciliation, technical debt, vendor dependency, and lifecycle risk through documented architecture actions.
* Consistently demonstrates strong work ethic, ownership, accountability, integrity, and sound judgment while fostering inclusive, respectful, and collaborative behavior, sharing knowledge, seeking diverse perspectives, and contributing positively to cross-functional team outcomes.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing medicines and vaccines for many of the world’s most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to advance innovative health solutions for people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
We seek a pragmatic and forward-looking architect who combines technical depth with product thinking and delivery focus. The successful candidate will be able to move between strategy and implementation, simplify complex ecosystems, establish trusted data foundations, guide cross-functional decisions, and create secure, compliant, interoperable, and sustainable digital capabilities for EHS.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Working at Abbott**
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You will also have access to :
  
  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit, an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**About Lingo**
Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers such as glucose, ketones, and lactate to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
As Staff Platform Engineer at Lingo, you will spend meaningful time building and operating alongside your team, taking ownership of technically complex platform work while also being responsible for the day-to-day allocation of work, tracking and providing feedback to Platform Engineers at the India location. You set the technical standard your team works to, you unblock them when problems are hard, and you make sure they have the clarity, context, and support to do their best work.
  
  
Azure is our primary cloud platform. You will bring strong hands-on Azure expertise and apply it across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and SRE practices, while developing your two direct reports to grow in the same disciplines.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Own the day-to-day work allocation for your team, ensuring engineers have well-scoped, meaningful work that matches their skills and develops their capabilities.
* Support your team through technical challenges, unblocking complex problems and guiding engineers toward solutions rather than solving everything yourself.
* Build, provision, and maintain Lingo's cloud infrastructure on Azure, taking ownership of technically complex or high-risk platform work alongside your team.
* Own and evolve key areas of Lingo's infrastructure-as-code foundation using Terraform or Bicep, including module design, standards, and code review for your team's contributions.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipeline architecture for Lingo's engineering teams, defining deployment patterns, environment promotion gates, and release automation standards that your team implements and operates.
* Lead from the front on SRE practices, contributing to SLO and SLI definitions, designing alerting and monitoring configurations, and driving post-incident reviews that generate real engineering improvements.
* Build and maintain observability tooling across Lingo's production environment, covering distributed tracing, log pipelines, and metrics collection, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need.
* Partner with product and feature engineering teams to support their deployment needs, onboard them to platform tooling, and reduce friction in the path from development to production.
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions with the Platform Engineer Lead and Senior Manager, providing practical input grounded in your day-to-day operational experience.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes in a way that supports knowledge sharing across Lingo's globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India.
* Identify process, tooling, and reliability improvements within your team's domain and drive them to completion with appropriate prioritization and stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications :**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering with hands-on work in a production environment.
* Strong hands-on Azure expertise, with production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, and security services.
* Solid infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent, including designing and reviewing reusable modules in a team environment.
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, including deployment automation and environment promotion.
* Working understanding of SRE principles including SLOs, SLIs, alerting strategies, on-call practices, and incident response and post-incident review workflows.
* Experience with observability tooling for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls including identity and access management, network security configurations, and secrets management.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure-native services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Security Center in a production context.
* Experience supporting IoT, biosensor, or real-time consumer health data platforms where data reliability and low-latency processing are critical.
* Familiarity with AIOps tooling and AI-driven observability practices, including anomaly detection and automated alerting.
* Background in MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, feature stores, and pipeline orchestration on cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud security and compliance frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI in an engineering context.
* Prior experience in a consumer technology company or high-growth digital health environment.

title: Senior Principal IT Architect
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This role sits within the Infrastructure & Operations organization, supporting the Platform Services team responsible for delivering foundational cloud platforms that enable enterprise technology, research, and business initiatives across Medtronic. The team focuses on cloud architecture, platform engineering, automation, security, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.
  
  
The position partners closely with Global Security, Application Services, Enterprise Architecture, and engineering teams to define and implement scalable platform capabilities including cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps automation, and emerging technologies.
  
  
This role is based at the Medtronic facility in Hyderabad, India and follows an onsite work model. Occasional travel may be required based on business needs.
  
  
We are seeking a senior cloud and platform architecture leader to drive the design, governance, automation, and evolution of enterprise cloud platforms across a multi-cloud environment. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic architecture leadership to build secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure solutions that support critical business and healthcare technology initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Define and govern enterprise cloud architecture patterns across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Design and implement Kubernetes-based platform solutions to support scalable and resilient application deployments.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Ansible.
* Architect and optimize DevOps and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to improve platform consistency, reliability, and deployment speed.
* Partner with security, application, and engineering teams to ensure platform solutions meet compliance, operational, and security requirements.
* Troubleshoot and optimize performance, networking, and reliability issues across large-scale distributed systems.
* Lead technology evaluations, technical consultations, and architecture discussions with internal stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives through automation, cloud adoption, and continuous improvement practices.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree with 18+ years of experience OR advanced degree with 16+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, cloud architecture, or DevOps engineering.
* Experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD automation frameworks.
* Experience leading architecture decisions and cross-functional technical initiatives in large-scale environments.
* Experience with security frameworks and technologies including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Kerberos, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), or Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) environments. Nice to Haves:
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Microsoft Azure certification, or equivalent cloud certification.
* Experience with Git-based version control platforms such as Gitlab, Github
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools including Splunk, Datadog, or AppDynamics.
* Experience architecting and managing Kubernetes platforms in enterprise environments

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
  
  
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Senior_Manager_Principal_Cloud_Engineer_Technical_Manager
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The position requires an experienced Senior Engineer with a strong focus on cloud native services, AI, Data Engineering, DevOps, Automation and creating reusable platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in designing complex systems, self-service user and admin portals and cloud-based services, with expert-level experience in AWS and additional experience in GCP or Azure being a plus. We are looking for someone who can learn a lot and quickly on the job, and we have projects using the latest and greatest technology and methodology.
  
  
The candidate must be able to code, develop, analyze and design end to end Cloud-Native solutions that uses AI and cloud services to automate complex tasks and simplify user experience. The candidate should have a deep understanding of DevOps/Infrastructure-As-Code (IaC) delivery models, Cloud Network, Security, Application architecture, genAI concepts, data engineering and usage models. The candidate must be experienced with Agile, DevOps and test-oriented system design philosophies, as well as ability to interface with other teams that may need education on cloud & AI best practices.
  
  

* The ideal candidate must be a strong Senior Developer and have experience using AWS services beyond just EC2s and Databases. Expertise in serverless, managed services, API-Governance, Basic Networking is required. Strong coding skills are expected.
* Skilled with AWS Step Functions, JavaScript, NodeJS and Python, especially  APIGW/Lambda and Elastic Beanstalks.
* Strong understanding of basic cloud networking is required to assist in troubleshooting and designing optimized solutions.
* The candidate must have hands-on experience with cloud projects and will be expected to demonstrate the ability to deliver quality script, code and test suites.
* Lead hands‑on implementation of AI‑enabled cloud solutions, while guiding teams on responsible, secure, and scalable AI usage within the platform.
* Lead, mentor, and grow high‑performing Cloud and DevOps engineering teams, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* The candidate must have demonstrated experience leading and managing high‑performing Cloud and DevOps engineering teams.
* Must have some experience with AI SDK and services, including genAI, prompt engineering, agents and using multiple LLM models.
* Must have working experience with deep-dive HTTPS troubleshooting,
* Must have lots of experience with REST API and design, GraphQL and React/CSS front end.
* The candidate should have demonstrated knowledge or experience with CloudFormation at scale and reuse, and the ability to influence multiple workstreams with reusable IaC components.
* The candidate should also have experience developing large-scale, multi-account, multi-region, serverless solutions on AWS and addressing all non-functional and AWS Well-Architected concerns in the design.
* Must be able to design for end-user simplicity while ensuring the system can handle complexity and exceptions internally.
* The candidate should have experience in breaking down projects into MVP and Agile deliverables, delivering complex end systems incrementally.
* Must be able to design for disaster recovery in IaaS Cloud platform and possess strong scripting skills, such as Python, Bash, Ruby, Perl, PowerShell, SSM, etc.
* Must have experience with managing substantial numbers of cloud accounts consistently using automation. Cloud SDK, CLI and scripting hands-on knowledge is necessary.
* Good listener and communicator. Strong verbal, non-verbal diagramming, and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal and external organizations
* Experience with working and building an automated build-pipeline, continuous integration, and continuous deployment. Experience with source code control repositories
* In-depth understanding of Interface-Contracts, Loosely Coupled designs and simplifying solutions and reducing TCO for the end-to-end picture.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.
  
  
**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

We are committed to attracting and selecting the very best people to join our team and to creating a workplace that promotes individual career growth; we value our people and their well-being. The group employs over 210 people from over 27 countries around the world with Assets Under Management and Administration of over 3 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Systems is responsible for CC Moneybase’s infrastructure, covering cloud, on-premises systems, networks and corporate IT. This role combines technical leadership with a hands-on approach, setting the direction while supporting the team in resolving complex technical challenges.
  
  
You will lead and develop the Systems team, ensuring our infrastructure is reliable, secure and resilient. Working closely with Information Security and other technology teams, you will drive modernisation, automation and continuous improvement to support the business as it grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership and ownership**

* Set and deliver the infrastructure roadmap, agreed with the CEO, covering modernisation, automation, resilience and cost.
* Own the infrastructure budget, licences and vendor relationships, and manage costs effectively, balancing efficiency and business needs.
* Lead, coach and develop the IT Systems Manager and, through them, the two systems engineers. Identify skills gaps and close them.
* Build a culture of ownership: every system has a named owner, documentation and a runbook.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex incidents, and lead post-incident reviews that fix root causes.

**Cloud: Microsoft Azure**

* Run and optimise our Azure estate: virtual machines, networking, storage, identity (Entra ID) and governance.
* Drive cost optimisation through right-sizing, reservations and removal of waste, reported monthly.

**On-premises and virtualisation**

* Oversee VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter, including VM management, performance monitoring, patching and upgrades.
* Own physical servers, virtualisation hosts and storage platforms through their full lifecycle.
* Manage hybrid connectivity and operations between on-premises and Azure so they work as one estate.

**Linux and server administration**

* Maintain and secure Linux servers across on-premises and cloud, including patching, hardening, troubleshooting and performance tuning.

**Corporate IT and end-user services**

* Own the corporate IT environment, setting the standards and direction for secure, reliable and well-managed IT services.
* Oversee end-user computing, including devices, operating systems, software deployment, patching and endpoint configuration.
* Establish and oversee identity and access management, including user provisioning, access controls, MFA, and joiner, mover and leaver processes.
* Define endpoint management and configuration standards using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Make sure corporate IT security controls, including endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance and vulnerability management, align with Information Security policies.
* Oversee the IT Systems Manager's delivery of IT support and services, including service levels, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Oversee IT assets, software licensing, suppliers and lifecycle planning to control cost and use resources well.
* Drive standardisation and automation of IT processes to improve efficiency, consistency and scalability.
* Make sure technical documentation, operational procedures, access controls and business continuity arrangements are kept up to date.
* Set performance expectations, review operational risks and service reporting, and give direction on corporate IT improvements and technology lifecycle decisions.

**Resilience and disaster recovery**

* Own infrastructure availability, backup and disaster recovery, and test recovery on a set schedule.
* Deliver the infrastructure security controls and operational resilience evidence the business needs, working with Risk, Compliance and Information Security.

**Automation and Infrastructure as Code**

* Move provisioning and configuration to code using Terraform, Ansible or equivalent, across cloud and on-premises.
* Standardise and automate routine operational tasks to cut manual effort and configuration drift.

**AI-assisted security and monitoring**

* Evaluate and implement AI-driven tools that continuously check configurations across Azure, VMware, Linux, Windows and network, and flag misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Use the AI and machine learning capabilities in our SIEM, EDR and monitoring platforms to improve anomaly detection and incident response.

**Essential**

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
This is a unique opportunity to join a high-caliber software engineering team that is growing quickly. You will play a key role in building impactful healthcare technology on a modern technology stack, with a focus on our core data and AI platforms. Your work will focus on enhancing the platform's key features, while also balancing scalability, reusability, and performance.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to serve as the technical backbone of our Engineering organization. You'll own the technical strategy, and delivery of our platform — spanning architecture, DevOps, SRE, security, Dev-ex.
  
  
This is a hands-on staff level role: you'll set technical direction, drive cross-team alignment, and be the senior escalation point for platform challenges.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive platform reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency across all environments.
* Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership for platform components, Influence the technical strategy and architecture of our cloud platform, from CI/CD pipelines to observability and incident response.
* Design and implement platform components and reusable integration patterns that minimize custom development efforts, reduce the time spent on repetitive tasks, and ensure that integrations scale across multiple healthcare systems
* Partner closely with Architecture, DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to deliver cohesive platform solutions
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product teams, and solutions architects to understand integration needs and ensure the platform meets current and future business requirements.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for infrastructure and platform incidents
* Establish frameworks for: AI governance and compliance. Observability of systems. Traceability of decisions and outputs. Ensure enterprise readiness with security, auditability, and reliability in production environments.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure all platform components and integrations comply with healthcare security and privacy regulations and adhere to industry best practices for data security.

**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**

* Good knowledge of Information practices.
* Assist the manager in all the information security activities implementation and maintenance process.
* Ensuring the team and imparted with Competence related to Information security
* Responsible for implementation of security policies and procedures and report any issues to the Information Security Manager.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years of software platform and infrastructure engineering experience, with 2+ years at Staff or Principal level (or equivalent impact)
* Deep expertise in AWS (ECS, Lambda, CloudFormation/Terraform, IAM, networking, security controls)
* Strong hands-on experience with containerization, designing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar) and GitOps workflows
* Production ownership mindset — you've owned SRE-level reliability (SLOs/SLIs, incident management, runbooks, post-mortems)
* Expertise in observability stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch, ELK/Kibana, or equivalent)
* Strong understanding of security engineering principles — secrets management, zero-trust networking, Okta, IAM policies, encryption at rest/in-transit.
* Ability to proactively identify and resolve platform issues, ensuring high availability, minimal downtime, and a streamlined integration experience for users.
* Experience in designing and building platforms, data processing, data warehousing, and integrated ML tooling.
* Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, operations, architecture) to ensure platform components meet the needs of the business.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, or similar) with working knowledge of compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST)
* Experience with data platform infrastructure — data pipelines, ETL orchestration (Step Functions, Glue, Airflow)
* Background in platform-as-a-product thinking — developer experience, internal tooling, self-service platforms
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling or published technical writing

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening
* Meet your Hiring Manager!
* Live System Design Exercise
* Project Retro
* Bar Raiser: Cross Functional Interview
* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health Company**
Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform delivers AI-powered solutions that streamline access to quality care by improving payer-provider collaboration, cost containment, and healthcare economics. Cohere Health works with over 660,000 providers and handles over 12 million prior authorization requests annually. Its responsible AI auto-approves up to 90% of requests for millions of health plan members.
  
  
Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We’ve been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners, Cohere Health drives more transparent, streamlined healthcare processes, helping patients receive faster, more appropriate care and higher-quality outcomes.
  
  
The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth-oriented environment that works for everyone.

title: Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable machine learning and Generative AI solutions supporting clinical, pharmacy, payer, and operational use cases
* Develop predictive models, recommendation systems, NLP solutions, deep learning models, and LLM-based applications to solve complex business problems
* Build and optimize data pipelines, feature engineering workflows, and model training frameworks using large-scale healthcare and business datasets
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector search solutions, prompt engineering techniques, and LLM evaluation frameworks
* Fine-tune and deploy foundation models while ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and performance
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps best practices including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, model deployment, experiment tracking, monitoring, and observability
* Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions
* Ensure adherence to Responsible AI principles, data governance standards, HIPAA requirements, and enterprise security controls
* Analyze model performance and continuously improve model accuracy, latency, cost, and user experience through experimentation and optimization
* Provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices and standards
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches that create measurable business value
* Support production AI systems through monitoring, issue resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 5+ years of professional software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI development experience
* 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production environments
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases
* Experience developing cloud-native solutions utilizing AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Knowledge of MLOps practices including model deployment, monitoring, experiment tracking, and CI/CD automation
* Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical modeling, and model evaluation
* Solid proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or equivalent
* Solid expertise in SQL, data modeling, and large-scale data processing technologies
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Databricks & Snowflake Infrastructure Engineer
description:

Deploy and configure Databricks workspaces, account-level settings, workspace networking, cluster policies, service principals, and Unity Catalog environments using Terraform and platform APIs.

Create reusable deployment accelerators, Terraform modules, platform blueprints, and operational runbooks to support enterprise-scale platform rollouts.

Minimum 7+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Platform Engineering.
  
  
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.
  
  
Minimum 5+ years of experience with AWS services, including VPCs, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, networking, and cloud security.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience deploying and administering Databricks on AWS, including workspace deployment, Unity Catalog, cluster policies, service principals, secrets management, and workspace networking.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience deploying and administering Snowflake, including account setup, database architecture, warehouses, RBAC, data sharing, security policies, and resource governance.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools.
  
  
Minimum 3+ years of experience implementing secure cloud architectures, including encryption, identity management, secrets management, and network isolation.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of experience developing automation and deployment scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  
  
Experience validating platform readiness, security controls, operational processes, monitoring, logging, and compliance requirements for production deployments.
  
  
Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, infrastructure governance, automated policy enforcement, and security compliance controls.
  
  
Experience working in Agile delivery environments with sprint-based development and stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead architecture reviews, deployment planning workshops, and technical validation sessions.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience deploying enterprise Databricks and Snowflake platforms supporting Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, and governance workloads.
  
  
Experience implementing Unity Catalog governance models, multi-workspace architectures, and cross-account AWS deployment patterns.
  
  
Experience configuring Snowflake network policies, private connectivity, SSO integration, SCIM provisioning, and advanced security features.
  
  
Experience supporting regulated financial services, banking, healthcare, or other highly governed environments.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities

Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.

Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer

We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

description:
